title.zh: 卷三百二十六 列傳第八十五 景泰 王信 蔣偕 張忠 郭恩 張岊 張君平 史方 盧鑑 李渭 王果 郭諮 田敏 侍其曙 康德輿 張昭遠
title.en: Volume 326 Biographies 85: Jing Tai, Wang Xin, Jiang Xie, Zhang Zhong, Guo En, Zhang Jie, Zhang Junping, Shi Fang, Lu Jian, Li Wei, Wang Guo, Guo Zi, Tian Min, Shi Qishu, Kang Deyu, Zhang Zhaoyuan
title.raw: 卷三百二十六 列傳第八十五 景泰 王信 蔣偕 張忠 郭恩 張岊 張君平 史方 盧鑑 李渭 王果 郭諮 田敏 侍其曙 康德輿 張昭遠 Volume 326 Biographies 85: Jing Tai, Wang Xin, Jiang Xie, Zhang Zhong, Guo En, Zhang Jie, Zhang Junping, Shi Fang, Lu Jian, Li Wei, Wang Guo, Guo Zi, Tian Min, Shi Qishu, Kang Deyu, Zhang Zhaoyuan

sentences.zh: 景泰，字周卿，普州人。

translations.literal: Jing Tai, style name Zhouqing, was a man of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Tai, whose courtesy name was Zhouqing, came from Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 進士起家，補坊州軍事推官。

translations.literal: He entered office through the jinshi and was appointed military judicial reviewer at Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Having entered service through the jinshi examination, he was appointed military judicial reviewer at Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 後以尚書屯田員外郎通判慶州，即上言：「元昊雖稱臣，誠恐包藏禍心。

translations.literal: Later, as External Subdivision Director of the Ministry of Works with concurrent duty as acting prefect of Qingzhou, he immediately submitted a memorial: "Although Yuan Hao has declared himself a subject, I truly fear he harbors treacherous intent.
translations.idiomatic: Later, while serving as External Subdivision Director of the Ministry of Works in charge of agricultural colonies with concurrent duty as acting prefect of Qingzhou, he immediately submitted a memorial: "Although Yuan Hao has submitted as a subject, I truly fear he harbors treacherous designs.

sentences.zh: 當選主將，練士卒，修城池，儲資糧，以備不虞。

translations.literal: One should select a chief general, drill soldiers, repair walls and moats, and store provisions and grain against the unexpected."
translations.idiomatic: We should select a chief general, drill the troops, repair the walls and moats, and stock provisions and grain against the unexpected."

sentences.zh: 」三疏不報。

translations.literal: Three memorials received no response.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted three such memorials, but none received a reply.

sentences.zh: 俄元昊反，又上《邊臣要略》二十卷。

translations.literal: Before long Yuan Hao rebelled, and he again submitted his Essential Points for Frontier Officials in twenty juan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yuan Hao rebelled, and he again submitted his Essential Points for Frontier Officials in twenty chapters.

sentences.zh: 遷都官、知成州，奏《平戎策》十有五篇。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director in the Ministry of Justice and appointed prefect of Chengzhou, and presented fifteen chapters of Strategies to Pacify the Rong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director in the Ministry of Justice and appointed prefect of Chengzhou, where he presented fifteen chapters of Strategies to Pacify the Rong.

sentences.zh: 會有薦泰知兵者，召對稱旨，換左藏庫使、知寧州。

translations.literal: When someone recommended Tai as knowledgeable in military affairs, he was summoned for an audience that pleased the throne, and was reassigned as Commissioner of the Left Repository and prefect of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When someone recommended Tai as skilled in military affairs, he was summoned for an audience that pleased the throne and was reassigned as Commissioner of the Left Repository and prefect of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 任福敗，徙原州。

translations.literal: After Ren Fu's defeat, he was transferred to Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Ren Fu's defeat, he was transferred to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 元昊眾十萬，分二道，一出劉璠堡，一出彭陽城，入攻渭州。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao had a force of one hundred thousand, divided in two columns, one emerging from Liu Fan Fort and one from Pengyang City, and advanced to attack Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hao fielded one hundred thousand men in two columns, one out of Liu Fan Fort and one out of Pengyang City, and marched to attack Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 葛懷敏援劉璠，戰崆峒北，敗沒，敵騎逾平涼，至潘原。

translations.literal: Ge Huaimin went to aid Liu Fan and fought north of Kongtong; he was defeated and perished, and the enemy cavalry crossed Pingliang and reached Panyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Huaimin went to relieve Liu Fan and fought north of Kongtong, but was defeated and killed; the enemy cavalry crossed Pingliang and reached Panyuan.

sentences.zh: 泰率兵五千，從間道赴原，而先鋒左班殿直張迥逗遛不進，泰斬以徇。

translations.literal: Tai led five thousand troops by a hidden route to Yuanzhou, but the vanguard, Left Team Palace Director Zhang Jiong, dallied and would not advance, so Tai executed him as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Tai led five thousand men by a hidden route to Yuanzhou, but his vanguard, Left Team Palace Director Zhang Jiong, dallied and would not advance, so Tai had him executed as an example.

sentences.zh: 遇敵彭陽西，裨將夏侯觀欲退守彭陽，泰弗許，乃依山而陣。

translations.literal: He encountered the enemy west of Pengyang; the deputy general Xiahou Guan wished to fall back and hold Pengyang, but Tai would not permit it and instead drew up his line along the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: West of Pengyang he met the enemy; the deputy Xiahou Guan wanted to fall back and hold Pengyang, but Tai refused and drew up his line along the hillside.

sentences.zh: 未成列，敵騎來犯，泰陰遣三百騎，分左右翼，張旗幟為疑兵。

translations.literal: Before the formation was complete, enemy horsemen came to attack; Tai secretly sent three hundred cavalry to left and right wings and raised banners as a deception.
translations.idiomatic: Before his line was fully formed, enemy horsemen attacked; Tai secretly sent three hundred cavalry to the left and right wings and raised banners to feign a larger force.

sentences.zh: 敵欲遁去，將校請進擊，泰止之，遣士搜山，果得伏兵，與戰，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: When the enemy wished to flee, the officers requested a pursuit, but Tai stopped them, sent men to search the hills, and indeed found ambush troops; he fought them and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy tried to withdraw, his officers asked to pursue, but Tai held them back, sent men to search the hills, and indeed found ambush troops; he fought them and took more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 以功遷西上閤門使、知鎮戎軍兼兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: For this merit he was promoted to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant and appointed prefect of Zhenrong Army with concurrent control as military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: For this achievement he was promoted to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant and appointed prefect of Zhenrong Army with concurrent command as military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 久之，領忠州刺史，徙秦鳳路馬步軍總管，卒。

translations.literal: After some time he held the Zhongzhou governorship in title and was transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Qinfeng Circuit infantry and cavalry; he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he held the title of Zhongzhou governor and was transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Qinfeng Circuit infantry and cavalry, where he died in office.

sentences.zh: 子思立，熙寧中屢有戰功，為引進使、忠州防禦使、知河州，與董氈部兵戰，沒，後思忠以左藏庫副使、遂州駐泊都監擊瀘州夷人，陷於羅箇暮山下。

translations.literal: His son Siliz, who repeatedly distinguished himself in campaigns during the Xining era, served as Reception Agent, Defender of Zhongzhou, and prefect of Hezhou; in battle with Dong Zhan's tribal forces he perished. Later Sizhong, as Assistant Commissioner of the Left Repository and Superintendent of Suizhou garrison, attacked Luzhou barbarians and was lost beneath Luogemushan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Siliz won repeated distinction in battle during the Xining era, rose to Reception Agent, Defender of Zhongzhou, and prefect of Hezhou, and was killed fighting the tribal forces of Dong Zhan. Later his brother Sizhong, as Assistant Commissioner of the Left Repository and Superintendent of the Suizhou garrison, attacked the Luzhou barbarians and was lost beneath Luogemushan.

sentences.zh: 兄弟繼死王事，人皆憐其忠。

translations.literal: The brothers died one after another in service to the throne, and all pitied their loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers died one after another in the service of the state, and all pitied their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 王信，字公亮，太原人。

translations.literal: Wang Xin, style name Gongliang, was a man of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xin, whose courtesy name was Gongliang, came from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 家故饒財，少勇悍。

translations.literal: His family was formerly wealthy, and in youth he was bold and fierce.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been wealthy, and in youth he was bold and fierce.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符中，盜起晉、絳、澤、潞數州，信應募籍軍，與其徒生擒賊七十人，累以功補龍、神衛指揮使。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong xiangfu era, bandits rose in Jin, Jiang, Ze, and Lu among several prefectures; Xin answered the call and enrolled in the army, and with his companions captured seventy bandits alive; through repeated merit he was appointed Commander in the Dragon and Divine Guards.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dazhong xiangfu era, when bandits rose in Jin, Jiang, Ze, Lu, and several other prefectures, Xin answered the call and enrolled in the army; with his companions he captured seventy bandits alive, and through repeated merit was appointed commander in the Dragon and Divine Guards.

sentences.zh: 部使者表薦，召閱其藝，遷御前忠佐，領河中府、同幹鄜延丹坊州慶成軍管界捉賊，又遷龍衛都虞候兼鄜延巡檢。

translations.literal: The circuit commissioner recommended him in a memorial; summoned to review his skills, he was promoted to Loyal Associate before the throne, and put in charge of bandit suppression in the jurisdictional areas of Hezhong prefecture, Tonggan, Yanzhou, Yan Circuit, Dan, Fang, Qing, Cheng, and Army garrisons; he was again transferred to Chief Assistant Commander of the Dragon Guards with concurrent command as Yan Circuit patrol inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit commissioner recommended him in a memorial; summoned to demonstrate his skills, he was promoted to Loyal Associate before the throne and placed in charge of bandit suppression across the jurisdictions of Hezhong prefecture, Tonggan, Yanzhou, Yan Circuit, Dan, Fang, Qing, Cheng, and Army garrisons; he was later transferred to Chief Assistant Commander of the Dragon Guards with concurrent duty as Yan Circuit patrol inspector.

sentences.zh: 康定初，劉平、石元孫戰於三川，信以所部兵薄賊，斬首數十級。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Kangding era, Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun fought at Sanchuan; Xin with his command pressed the bandits and beheaded several tens.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kangding era, when Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun fought at Sanchuan, Xin pressed the enemy with his command and took several dozen heads.

sentences.zh: 遷捧日都虞候，改西京作坊使、知鎮戎軍，徙保安軍兼鄜延路兵馬都監。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Chief Assistant Commander of the Holding-Sun Corps, changed to Commissioner of the Western Capital Arsenal and prefect of Zhenrong Army, then transferred to Bao'an Army with concurrent status as Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Yan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Chief Assistant Commander of the Holding-Sun Corps, appointed Commissioner of the Western Capital Arsenal and prefect of Zhenrong Army, and then transferred to Bao'an Army with concurrent duty as Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Yan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 始至之夕，敵眾號數萬傅城，軍吏氣懾。

translations.literal: On the evening of his first arrival, enemy forces said to number in the tens of thousands pressed the walls, and the officers and clerks were cowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening he first arrived, enemy forces said to number in the tens of thousands pressed against the walls, and the officers lost their nerve.

sentences.zh: 信領勁兵二千，夜出南門與戰，失其前鋒，因按軍不動。

translations.literal: Xin led two thousand crack troops, went out the south gate at night to fight, lost his vanguard, and therefore held the army still.
translations.idiomatic: Xin led two thousand crack troops out the south gate at night to fight; when he lost his vanguard, he held the army in place.

sentences.zh: 遲明，潛上東山整軍，乘勢而下，擊走之，獲首級、馬牛居多。

translations.literal: At daybreak he secretly ascended East Hill to reorganize the army, then came down with the momentum and drove them off, capturing many heads, horses, and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak he secretly climbed East Hill to reorganize his troops, then swept down the slope and drove the enemy off, taking a great many heads, horses, and cattle.

sentences.zh: 遷鈐轄兼經略、安撫、招討都監，領貴州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner with concurrent duties as frontier commissioner, pacification commissioner, and pacification-and-suppression superintendent, and held the Guizhou governorship in title.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to military commissioner with concurrent duties as frontier commissioner, pacification commissioner, and pacification-and-suppression superintendent, and held the title of Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 葛懷敏戰敗，信出兵拒敵，俘斬甚眾。

translations.literal: When Ge Huaimin was defeated, Xin led troops out to resist the enemy and captured and beheaded a great many.
translations.idiomatic: When Ge Huaimin was defeated, Xin led troops out to resist the enemy and captured or killed a great many.

sentences.zh: 進保州刺史，就遷馬步軍都總管。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Bao'an prefect and at the same time transferred to Commander-in-Chief of infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Bao'an and at the same time appointed Commander-in-Chief of infantry and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 四路置招討使，遂為本路招討副使。

translations.literal: When pacification commissioners were established for the four circuits, he became deputy pacification commissioner for his circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When pacification commissioners were established for the four frontier circuits, he became deputy pacification commissioner for his own circuit.

sentences.zh: 累遷馬步軍都虞候、象州防禦使，徙高陽關路。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he became Chief Assistant Commander of infantry and cavalry and Defender of Xiangzhou, and was transferred to Gaoyang Pass Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Through repeated promotions he rose to Chief Assistant Commander of infantry and cavalry and Defender of Xiangzhou, and was transferred to Gaoyang Pass Circuit.

sentences.zh: 王則反貝州，用安撫使明鎬奏，為貝州城下都總管。

translations.literal: When Wang Ze rebelled at Beizhou, on the memorial of Pacification Commissioner Ming Hao he was made Commander-in-Chief below the walls of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Ze rebelled at Beizhou, on the recommendation of Pacification Commissioner Ming Hao he was appointed Commander-in-Chief below the walls of Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 城破，則遁，信率兵執則而還，餘黨自焚死。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Ze fled; Xin led troops, seized Ze, and returned; the remaining partisans burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Ze fled; Xin led his troops, captured Ze, and returned, while the remaining rebels burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 拜感德軍節度觀察留後，召為步軍副都指揮使，未至，卒。

translations.literal: He was appointed Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Gande Army in acting capacity, summoned as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Foot Soldiers, but before he arrived he died.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Gande Army and summoned as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Foot Soldiers, but died before he could take up the post.

sentences.zh: 贈武寧軍節度兼侍中。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Military Governorship of Wuning Army with concurrent status as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of Military Governor of Wuning Army with concurrent status as Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 蔣偕，字齊賢，華州鄭縣人。

translations.literal: Jiang Xie, style name Qixian, was a man of Zheng County in Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Xie, whose courtesy name was Qixian, came from Zheng County in Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 幼貧，有立志。

translations.literal: In youth he was poor but had firm resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Though poor in youth, he held firm resolve.

sentences.zh: 父病，嘗刲股以療，父愈，詰之曰：「此豈孝邪？

translations.literal: When his father fell ill, he once cut flesh from his thigh to treat him; when his father recovered, he questioned him, saying, "Is this filial conduct?"
translations.idiomatic: When his father fell ill, he once cut flesh from his thigh to treat him; when his father recovered, he questioned him: "Is this truly filial conduct?"

sentences.zh: 」曰：「情之所感，實不自知也。

translations.literal: He replied, "It was moved by feeling; I truly did not know what I was doing."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "I was moved by feeling and truly did not know what I was doing."

sentences.zh: 」舉進士，補韶州司理參軍，以秘書省著作佐郎為大理寺詳斷官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, was appointed judicial assistant at Shaozhou, and served as detailed adjudicator at the Court of Judicial Review in the capacity of Assistant Compiler in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and was appointed judicial assistant at Shaozhou; later, while serving as Assistant Compiler in the Secretariat, he was made detailed adjudicator at the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 密州豪人王澥使奴殺一家四人，偕當澥及奴皆大辟。

translations.literal: The powerful man of Mizhou, Wang Xie, had a slave kill four members of one household; Xie judged that Xie and the slave should both receive the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xie, a powerful man of Mizhou, had a slave kill four members of one household; Jiang Xie ruled that both Wang Xie and the slave should receive the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 宰相陳堯佐欲寬澥，判審刑院宋庠與偕持之不從，偕以是知名。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Chen Yaozuo wished to lighten Xie's sentence; Song Qi, who presided over the Court for Judicial Review, and Xie held to their view and would not yield; Xie became famous for this.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Chen Yaozuo wished to lighten Wang Xie's sentence, but Song Qi, who presided over the Court for Judicial Review, and Jiang Xie held firm and would not yield; Jiang Xie became famous for this.

sentences.zh: 陝西用兵，數上書論邊事，遷秘書丞、通判同州，計置陝西錢糧。

translations.literal: When war was waged in Shaanxi, he repeatedly submitted memorials discussing frontier affairs; he was promoted to Secretariat Director and acting prefect of Tongzhou, and arranged funds and grain for Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When war broke out in Shaanxi, he repeatedly submitted memorials on frontier affairs; he was promoted to Secretariat Director and acting prefect of Tongzhou, with responsibility for arranging funds and grain for Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 逾年，為沿邊計置青白鹽使。

translations.literal: After more than a year, he became Commissioner for Arranging Green-and-White Salt along the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year, he was appointed Commissioner for Arranging Green-and-White Salt along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 用龐籍、范仲淹薦，改北作坊副使、環慶路兵馬都監，歷知汾、涇二州，徙原州。

translations.literal: On the recommendation of Pang Ji and Fan Zhongyan, he was changed to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal and Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Huanqing Circuit, successively served as prefect of Fen and Jing, and was transferred to Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the recommendation of Pang Ji and Fan Zhongyan, he was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal and Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Huanqing Circuit, served successively as prefect of Fen and Jing, and was transferred to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 邊民苦屬戶為鈔盜，偕得數輩，腰斬境上，盜為息。

translations.literal: Frontier commoners suffered because dependent households acted as salt smugglers; Xie captured several parties and cut them in two at the waist on the border, and the smuggling ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier commoners suffered because dependent households acted as salt smugglers; Xie captured several of them and had them cut in two at the waist on the border, after which the smuggling ceased.

sentences.zh: 遷北作坊使兼本路鈐轄，明珠、康奴諸族數為寇，偕潛兵伺之，斬首四百，擒酋豪，焚帳落，獲馬、牛、羊千計。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal with concurrent duty as military commissioner of the circuit; the Mingzhu, Kangnu, and other tribes repeatedly raided; Xie sent troops secretly to watch them, beheaded four hundred, captured chieftains, burned encampments, and seized more than a thousand horses, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal with concurrent duty as military commissioner of the circuit; when the Mingzhu, Kangnu, and other tribes repeatedly raided, Xie sent troops in secret to ambush them, took four hundred heads, captured tribal chieftains, burned their encampments, and seized more than a thousand horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 所俘皆刳割磔裂於庭下，坐客為廢飲食，而偕語笑自若。

translations.literal: All captives were disemboweled, quartered, and torn apart in the courtyard below; seated guests could not eat or drink, but Xie spoke and laughed as if at ease.
translations.idiomatic: He had all the captives disemboweled, quartered, and torn apart in the courtyard below; his seated guests could not eat or drink, but Xie spoke and laughed as if nothing were amiss.

sentences.zh: 徙華州兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military commissioner of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 湖南蠻唐和內寇，徙潭州鈐轄。

translations.literal: When the Hunan barbarian Tang He raided within the borders, he was transferred to military commissioner of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hunan barbarian Tang He raided within the borders, he was transferred to military commissioner of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊平，知忻州，徙冀州。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he was appointed prefect of Xinzhou and transferred to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were pacified, he was appointed prefect of Xinzhou and later transferred to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 坐擅率糧草。

translations.literal: He was punished for unauthorized requisition of grain and fodder.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for unauthorized requisition of grain and fodder.

sentences.zh: 降知霸州。

translations.literal: He was demoted to prefect of Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to prefect of Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 逾年，徙恩州，領韶州刺史。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was transferred to Enzhou and held the Shaozhou governorship in title.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was transferred to Enzhou and held the title of Shaozhou governor.

sentences.zh: 屬兵糧乏絕，朝廷方募民入粟，增虛直，給券詣京師射取錢貨，謂之交鈔，患未有應令者，偕使州倉謬為入粟數，輒作鈔，遣屬官持至京師轉貿，得緡錢以補軍食。

translations.literal: As military grain was exhausted, the court was recruiting commoners to contribute grain, raising nominal prices, and issuing certificates to go to the capital to draw money and goods, called exchange notes; it feared no one would respond to the order; Xie had the state granary falsely report grain contributions, immediately made notes, sent subordinate officials to carry them to the capital to trade, and obtained strings of cash to supplement army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: As military grain ran out, the court was recruiting commoners to contribute grain, raising nominal prices, and issuing certificates redeemable in the capital for money and goods, called exchange notes, but feared no one would respond; Xie had the state granary falsely report grain contributions, immediately issued notes, sent subordinate officials to carry them to the capital to trade, and obtained cash to supplement army provisions.

sentences.zh: 為御史彈奏，降知坊州。

translations.literal: He was impeached by the censorate and demoted to prefect of Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate impeached him, and he was demoted to prefect of Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 儂智高反，除宮苑使、韶州團練使，為廣南東西路鈐轄。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao rebelled, he was appointed Palace Parks Commissioner and Training Commissioner of Shaozhou, and made military commissioner of the Eastern and Western Guangnan Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao rebelled, he was appointed Palace Parks Commissioner and Training Commissioner of Shaozhou and made military commissioner of the Eastern and Western Guangnan Circuits.

sentences.zh: 賊方圍廣州。

translations.literal: The bandits were then besieging Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were then besieging Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 偕馳傳十七日至城下。

translations.literal: Xie raced by relay seventeen days to reach below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Xie raced by relay post seventeen days to reach the city.

sentences.zh: 戰士未集，會儂智高徙軍沙頭，安撫楊畋檄偕焚糧儲，退保韶州。

translations.literal: The fighting men had not yet assembled; it happened that Nong Zhigao moved his army to Shatou; Pacification Commissioner Yang Tian ordered Xie by dispatch to burn grain stores and fall back to defend Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His troops had not yet assembled when Nong Zhigao moved his army to Shatou; Pacification Commissioner Yang Tian ordered Xie by dispatch to burn the grain stores and fall back to defend Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 坐此，降潭州駐泊都監，再降北作坊使、忠州刺史。

translations.literal: For this he was demoted to Superintendent of the Tanzhou garrison, and again demoted to Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal and prefect of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: For this he was demoted to Superintendent of the Tanzhou garrison, and demoted again to Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal and prefect of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 命未至，軍次賀州太平場，賊夜入營，襲殺之。

translations.literal: Before the order arrived, the army halted at Taiping Field in Hezhou; bandits entered the camp at night and killed him in a surprise attack.
translations.idiomatic: Before the order arrived, his army halted at Taiping Field in Hezhou; rebels entered the camp at night and killed him in a surprise attack.

sentences.zh: 贈武信軍節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Wuxin Army in acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of acting Military Governor and Observation Commissioner of Wuxin Army.

sentences.zh: 初，偕入廣州，即數知州仲簡曰：「君留兵自守，不襲賊，又縱步兵馘平民以幸賞，可斬也！

translations.literal: Earlier, when Xie entered Guangzhou, he repeatedly told the prefect Zhong Jian, "You keep troops to defend yourself, do not strike the bandits, and moreover let foot soldiers cut off civilians' ears to seek rewards — you deserve execution!"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Xie entered Guangzhou, he repeatedly told Prefect Zhong Jian, "You keep your troops to defend yourself and do not strike the rebels, and you even let your foot soldiers cut off civilians' ears to claim rewards — you deserve execution!"

sentences.zh: 」簡曰：「安有團練使欲斬侍從官？

translations.literal: Jian said, "How can a training commissioner wish to execute a palace attendant?"
translations.idiomatic: Jian said, "How can a training commissioner wish to execute a palace attendant?"

sentences.zh: 」偕曰：「斬諸侯劍在吾手，何論侍從！

translations.literal: Xie said, "The sword to execute feudal lords is in my hand — what matter is a palace attendant!"
translations.idiomatic: Xie said, "The sword that executes feudal lords is in my hand — what matter is a palace attendant!"

sentences.zh: 」左右解之，乃止。

translations.literal: Those at his side explained the matter, and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Those at his side intervened, and he desisted.

sentences.zh: 卒以輕肆敗。

translations.literal: In the end he was ruined through rashness.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he was ruined by his own rashness.

sentences.zh: 張忠，開封人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhong was a man of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhong came from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 初隸龍騎備征，選為教駿。

translations.literal: At first he was attached to the Dragon Cavalry as a reserve for campaigns and was selected as horse trainer.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served in the Dragon Cavalry as a reserve for campaigns and was selected as a horse trainer.

sentences.zh: 有軍校恣掊斂，忠歐殺之，坐配鼎州。

translations.literal: A military school officer extorted at will; Zhong beat him to death and was sentenced to exile at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When a military school officer extorted at will, Zhong beat him to death and was sentenced to exile at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 既遁去為盜，復招出。

translations.literal: After he fled and became a bandit, he was again recruited back.
translations.idiomatic: After he fled and became a bandit, he was recruited back into service.

sentences.zh: 隸龍猛軍，以材武補三班借職、陝西總管司指使。

translations.literal: He was attached to the Dragon Fierce Army; for talent and martial skill he was appointed Acting Third-Rank Officer and Command Agent of the Shaanxi Commandery Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was attached to the Dragon Fierce Army and, for his talent and martial skill, was appointed Acting Third-Rank Officer and command agent of the Shaanxi Commandery Office.

sentences.zh: 數攻破堡砦，殺劇賊張海、郭邈山。

translations.literal: He repeatedly stormed forts and stockades and killed the notorious bandits Zhang Hai and Guo Miaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly stormed forts and stockades and killed the notorious bandits Zhang Hai and Guo Miaoshan.

sentences.zh: 從平恩州，功第一。

translations.literal: He followed in the pacification of Enzhou and ranked first in merit.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in pacifying Enzhou and ranked first in merit.

sentences.zh: 累遷如京使、資州刺史，歷真定府、定州、高陽關、京東西路兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he became Commissioner Bearing Credentials to the Capital and prefect of Zizhou, and successively served as military commissioner of Zhending prefecture, Dingzhou, Gaoyang Pass, and Jingdong West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Through repeated promotions he rose to Commissioner Bearing Credentials to the Capital and prefect of Zizhou, and served successively as military commissioner of Zhending prefecture, Dingzhou, Gaoyang Pass, and Jingdong West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 儂智高反，就移廣東，領英州團練使。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao rebelled, he was immediately transferred to Guangdong and held the Yingzhou training commissionership in title.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao rebelled, he was immediately transferred to Guangdong and held the title of Training Commissioner of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，智高圍廣州，時洪州駐泊都監蔡保恭及知英州蘇緘以兵八千人據邊渡村，扼賊歸路，忠奪而將之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhigao besieged Guangzhou, the Hongzhou garrison superintendent Cai Baogong and the Yingzhou prefect Su Jian with eight thousand troops held Biandu Village and blocked the bandits' route of return; Zhong seized command and led them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhigao besieged Guangzhou, Hongzhou garrison superintendent Cai Baogong and Yingzhou prefect Su Jian held Biandu Village with eight thousand troops to block the rebels' line of retreat; Zhong took over command of their force.

sentences.zh: 謂其下曰：「我十年前一健兒，以戰功為團練使，若曹勉之。

translations.literal: He told his subordinates, "Ten years ago I was a mere stalwart who became training commissioner through battle merit — you should exert yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: He told his men, "Ten years ago I was nothing but a stalwart who rose to training commissioner through battle merit — you should exert yourselves."

sentences.zh: 」於是不介騎而前。

translations.literal: Thereupon he went forward without armor or mount.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he advanced without armor or a mount.

sentences.zh: 會先鋒遇賊奔，忠手拉賊帥二人，馬陷濘，不能奮，遂中標槍死。

translations.literal: It happened that the vanguard met the bandits and fled; Zhong seized two bandit chiefs with his hands, but his horse sank in the mire and could not struggle free, and he was struck by a javelin and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the vanguard met the rebels and broke, Zhong seized two rebel chiefs with his bare hands, but his horse sank in the mire and could not struggle free, and he was struck by a javelin and killed.

sentences.zh: 錄其父率府副率致仕餘慶為左監門衛大將軍，賜第一區，給半俸終身；

translations.literal: His father, retired Vice Commandant of the Leading Palace Yu Qing, was enrolled as Senior General of the Left Gate Guard, granted one residence, and given half salary for life;
translations.idiomatic: His father, the retired Vice Commandant of the Leading Palace Yu Qing, was enrolled as Senior General of the Left Gate Guard, granted a residence, and given half salary for life;

sentences.zh: 封其母為河內郡夫人；

translations.literal: his mother was enfeoffed as Lady of Hedong Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: his mother was enfeoffed as Lady of Hedong Commandery;

sentences.zh: 弟願遷右班殿直、閤門祗候；

translations.literal: his younger brother Yuan was transferred to Right Team Palace Director and Chamberlain Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: his younger brother Yuan was promoted to Right Team Palace Director and Chamberlain Attendant;

sentences.zh: 官其子永壽、永吉、永德及其婿劉錞凡四人。

translations.literal: his sons Yongshou, Yongji, and Yongde and his son-in-law Liu Zun, four persons in all, were given office.
translations.idiomatic: his sons Yongshou, Yongji, and Yongde and his son-in-law Liu Zun, four men in all, were given office.

sentences.zh: 封長女為清河縣君。

translations.literal: His eldest daughter was enfeoffed as Lady of Qinghe County.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest daughter was enfeoffed as Lady of Qinghe County.

sentences.zh: 郭恩，開封人。

translations.literal: Guo En was a man of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Guo En came from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 初隸諸班，出為左侍禁、閤門祗候，歷延州西路都巡檢、環州肅遠砦主，累遷內殿承制、秦鳳路兵馬都監。

translations.literal: At first he was attached to the various guard units; he went out as Left Palace Attendant and Chamberlain Attendant, served as Chief Patrol Inspector of Yanzhou West Route and master of Su'yuan Stockade in Huanzhou, and through repeated promotions became Inner Hall Artisan and Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Qinfeng Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served in the various guard units, then was appointed Left Palace Attendant and Chamberlain Attendant; he served as Chief Patrol Inspector of Yanzhou West Route and master of Su'yuan Stockade in Huanzhou, and through repeated promotions rose to Inner Hall Artisan and Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Qinfeng Circuit.

sentences.zh: 開古渭州路，為前鋒，斬首九百餘級，擢崇儀副使。

translations.literal: He opened the route to ancient Weizhou, served as vanguard, and beheaded more than nine hundred; he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of Honored Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: When he opened the route to ancient Weizhou as vanguard, he took more than nine hundred heads and was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of Honored Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 會掌烏族叛，又率兵攻討，斬首八十五級，遷六宅副使。

translations.literal: When the Zhangwu tribe rebelled, he again led troops to attack and suppress them, beheaded eighty-five, and was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Six Residences.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhangwu tribe rebelled, he again led troops against them, took eighty-five heads, and was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Six Residences.

sentences.zh: 累勞，補崇儀使，為秦隴路兵馬鈐轄，徙幷、代州鈐轄，管勾麟府軍馬事。

translations.literal: Through accumulated labor he was appointed Commissioner of Honored Ceremonial, made military commissioner of Qinlong Circuit, transferred to military commissioner of Bing and Dai, and supervised military affairs of Linfu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Through accumulated service he was appointed Commissioner of Honored Ceremonial, made military commissioner of Qinlong Circuit, transferred to military commissioner of Bing and Dai, and put in charge of military affairs at Linfu Army.

sentences.zh: 夏人歲侵屈野河西地，至耕獲時，輒屯兵河西以誘官軍。

translations.literal: The Xia people each year encroached on the land west of the Quye River; when it came time for plowing and harvest, they would station troops west of the river to lure government forces.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia each year encroached on the land west of the Quye River, and at plowing and harvest time would station troops west of the river to lure government forces across.

sentences.zh: 經略使龐籍每戒邊將，斂兵河東毋與戰。

translations.literal: The frontier commissioner Pang Ji repeatedly warned frontier generals to keep troops east of the river and not engage in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier Commissioner Pang Ji repeatedly warned frontier generals to keep their troops east of the river and not engage.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐二年，自正月出屯，至三月然後去。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiayou, from the first month they came out to encamp, and only in the third month did they leave.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiayou they encamped from the first month and did not withdraw until the third.

sentences.zh: 通判幷州司馬光行邊至河西白草平，數十里無寇跡。

translations.literal: Acting prefect of Bingzhou Sima Guang toured the frontier and reached Baicao Plain west of the river; for several tens of li there were no traces of raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Acting prefect of Bingzhou Sima Guang toured the frontier as far as Baicao Plain west of the river and found no sign of raiders for several tens of li.

sentences.zh: 是時，知麟州武戡、通判夏倚已築一堡為候望，又與光議曰：「乘敵去，出不意可更增二堡，以據其地。

translations.literal: At this time the Linzhou prefect Wu Kan and acting prefect Xia Yi had already built one fort as a lookout, and again discussed with Guang, saying, "While the enemy has gone, we can unexpectedly add two more forts to occupy the ground."
translations.idiomatic: At this time Linzhou prefect Wu Kan and acting prefect Xia Yi had already built one fort as a lookout post, and discussed with Guang: "Now that the enemy has withdrawn, we can unexpectedly add two more forts to hold the ground."

sentences.zh: 請還白經略使，益禁兵三千、役兵五百，不過二旬，壁壘可城。

translations.literal: Please return and inform the frontier commissioner; add three thousand forbidden troops and five hundred corvée soldiers, and in no more than twenty days the ramparts can be walled.
translations.idiomatic: Please return and inform the frontier commissioner; with three thousand more regular troops and five hundred corvée laborers, the ramparts can be walled in no more than twenty days.

sentences.zh: 然後廢橫戎、臨塞二堡，徹其樓櫓，徙其甲兵，以實新堡，列烽燧以通警急。

translations.literal: Then abolish the two forts of Hengwu and Linse, dismantle their towers and parapets, move their armor and troops to fill the new forts, and set out beacon fires to communicate urgent alarms.
translations.idiomatic: Then abolish the two forts of Hengwu and Linse, dismantle their towers and parapets, move their armor and troops to strengthen the new forts, and set out beacon fires to relay urgent alarms.

sentences.zh: 從衙城紅樓之上，俯瞰其地，猶指掌也。

translations.literal: From atop the Red Tower of the yamen city, one looks down on the ground as if it lay in the palm of the hand.
translations.idiomatic: From atop the yamen city's Red Tower, one can look down on the ground as if it lay in the palm of one's hand.

sentences.zh: 有急，則州及橫陽堡出兵救之；

translations.literal: If there is urgency, the prefecture and Hengyang Fort will send troops to rescue them;
translations.idiomatic: In an emergency, the prefecture and Hengyang Fort would send troops to relieve them;

sentences.zh: 敵來耕則驅之，種則蹂踐之；

translations.literal: when the enemy comes to plow, drive them off; when they sow, trample the fields;
translations.idiomatic: when the enemy came to plow, they would drive them off; when they sowed, they would trample the fields;

sentences.zh: 敵盛則入堡以避。

translations.literal: when the enemy is strong, enter the fort to avoid them.
translations.idiomatic: when the enemy grew strong, they would enter the fort for shelter.

sentences.zh: 如是，則堡外必不敢耕種，州西五六十里之內晏然矣。

translations.literal: In this way, outside the fort they will certainly not dare to plow or sow, and within fifty or sixty li west of the prefecture all will be secure.
translations.idiomatic: In this way, the enemy would not dare to farm outside the forts, and the fifty or sixty li west of the prefecture would remain secure.

sentences.zh: 」籍遂檄麟州如其議。

translations.literal: Ji then issued a dispatch to Linzhou to carry out the plan as discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Ji then issued a dispatch to Linzhou ordering the plan carried out as discussed.

sentences.zh: 五月，恩及武戡、走馬承受公事內侍黃道元等以巡邊為名，往按視之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, En together with Wu Kan, the palace courier eunuch Huang Daoyuan on inspection duty, and others, under the name of touring the frontier, went to inspect the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, En, together with Wu Kan, the palace courier eunuch Huang Daoyuan on inspection duty, and others, went to inspect the frontier on that pretext.

sentences.zh: 會詗者言，敵兵盛屯沙黍浪，恩欲止不行。

translations.literal: It happened that scouts reported the enemy had massed at Shatai Lang; En wished to stop and not go.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts then reported that the enemy had massed at Shatai Lang, and En wished to halt and not proceed.

sentences.zh: 道元怒，以言脅恩，夜率步騎一千四百餘人，不甲者半，循屈野河北而行，無復部伍。

translations.literal: Daoyuan grew angry and threatened En with words; at night he led more than fourteen hundred foot and horse, half without armor, and marched along the north bank of the Quye River with no formation left.
translations.idiomatic: Daoyuan grew angry and threatened En; that night he led more than fourteen hundred foot and horse, half without armor, along the north bank of the Quye River with no formation remaining.

sentences.zh: 夏人舉火臥牛峰，戡指以謂恩曰：「敵已知吾軍至矣。

translations.literal: The Xia kindled fires on Woniufeng; Kan pointed and told En, "The enemy already knows our army has arrived."
translations.idiomatic: The Xia lit fires on Woniufeng; Kan pointed and told En, "The enemy already knows our army has arrived."

sentences.zh: 」道元曰：「此爾曹故欲沮我師。

translations.literal: Daoyuan said, "This is just you people trying to discourage our army."
translations.idiomatic: Daoyuan said, "This is just you people trying to discourage our army."

sentences.zh: 」及聞皷聲，道元猶不信。

translations.literal: Even when they heard drums, Daoyuan still did not believe.
translations.idiomatic: Even when they heard drums, Daoyuan still would not believe it.

sentences.zh: 行至穀口，恩欲休軍，須曉乃登山。

translations.literal: When they reached the mouth of the valley, En wished to rest the army and wait until dawn before ascending the hill.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the mouth of the valley, En wished to rest the army and wait until dawn before climbing the hill.

sentences.zh: 道元奮衣起曰：「幾年聞郭恩名，今日懦怯與賈逵何殊？

translations.literal: Daoyuan flung off his robe and rose, saying, "For years I have heard the name Guo En — today your cowardice is no different from Jia Kui's!"
translations.idiomatic: Daoyuan flung off his robe and rose, saying, "For years I have heard the name Guo En — today your cowardice is no different from Jia Kui's!"

sentences.zh: 」恩亦慍曰：「不過死耳！

translations.literal: En also said angrily, "It is nothing more than death!"
translations.idiomatic: En snapped back angrily, "It is nothing more than death!"

sentences.zh: 」乃行。

translations.literal: and they went on.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they marched on.

sentences.zh: 比明，至忽里堆。

translations.literal: By daybreak they reached Huli Dui.
translations.idiomatic: By daybreak they reached Huli Dui.

sentences.zh: 敵數十人皆西走，相去數十步止。

translations.literal: Several tens of the enemy all went west, stopping several tens of paces away.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of the enemy all went west and halted several tens of paces away.

sentences.zh: 恩等踞胡床，遣使騎呼之，敵不應，亦不動。

translations.literal: En and the others sat on folding chairs and sent mounted messengers to call them; the enemy did not answer and did not move.
translations.idiomatic: En and the others sat on folding chairs and sent mounted messengers to call to them; the enemy neither answered nor moved.

sentences.zh: 俄而起火，敵騎張左右翼，自南北交至。

translations.literal: Before long fires rose, and enemy horsemen spread left and right wings, arriving from north and south at once.
translations.idiomatic: Before long fires rose, and enemy horsemen spread to left and right wings, arriving from north and south at once.

sentences.zh: 堆東有塹，其中有梁，謂之「斷道堰」。

translations.literal: East of the mound was a trench, and within it a beam-bridge called the "Broken Road Weir."
translations.idiomatic: East of the mound was a trench, and within it a beam-bridge called the "Broken Road Weir."

sentences.zh: 恩等東據梁口，與力戰，自旦至食。

translations.literal: En and the others held the bridge mouth on the east and fought hard from dawn until the hour of eating.
translations.idiomatic: En and the others held the bridge mouth on the east and fought hard from dawn until mealtime.

sentences.zh: 時敵自兩旁塹中攀緣而上，四面合擊，恩眾大潰。

translations.literal: At that time the enemy climbed up from trenches on both sides and attacked from four directions; En's force collapsed in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the enemy climbed up from trenches on both sides and attacked from four directions, and En's force collapsed in great disorder.

sentences.zh: 夏倚方在紅樓，見敵騎自西山大下，與推官劉公弼率城中諸軍，閉門乘城。

translations.literal: Xia Yi was then at the Red Tower; seeing enemy horsemen sweep down from the western hills, he and the judicial aide Liu Gongbi led all troops in the city, closed the gates, and manned the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yi was then at the Red Tower; seeing enemy horsemen sweep down from the western hills, he and the judicial aide Liu Gongbi led all troops in the city, closed the gates, and manned the walls.

sentences.zh: 武戡走東山，趣城東，抉門以入。

translations.literal: Wu Kan fled to East Hill and hurried to the east of the city, prying open the gate to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kan fled to East Hill and hurried to the east of the city, prying open the gate to enter.

sentences.zh: 恩、道元及府州寧府砦兵馬都監劉慶皆被執。

translations.literal: En, Daoyuan, and the Fuzhou Ningfu Stockade Infantry and Cavalry Commander Liu Qing were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: En, Daoyuan, and the Fuzhou Ningfu Stockade Infantry and Cavalry Commander Liu Qing were all captured.

sentences.zh: 使臣死者五人，軍士三百八十七人，已馘耳鼻得還者百餘人，亡失器甲甚眾。

translations.literal: Five envoys died, three hundred eighty-seven soldiers, and of those who returned with ears and noses cut off there were more than a hundred; lost weapons and armor were very many.
translations.idiomatic: Five envoys died, along with three hundred eighty-seven soldiers; more than a hundred returned with ears and noses cut off, and a great quantity of weapons and armor was lost.

sentences.zh: 恩不肯降，乃自殺。

translations.literal: En refused to surrender and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: En refused to surrender and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 贈同州觀察使，封其妻為京兆郡君，錄其子弟有差，給舊俸三年。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Observation Commissioner of Tongzhou; his wife was enfeoffed as Lady of Jingzhao Commandery; his sons and younger brothers were enrolled in office according to rank, and his former salary was given for three years.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Observation Commissioner of Tongzhou; his wife was enfeoffed as Lady of Jingzhao Commandery; his sons and younger brothers were enrolled in office according to rank, and his former salary was given for three years.

sentences.zh: 武戡坐棄軍除名，編管江州。

translations.literal: Wu Kan was punished for abandoning the army, removed from the rolls, and banished to supervise Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kan was punished for abandoning the army, removed from the rolls, and banished to supervise Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 張岊，字子雲，府州府谷人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jie, style name Ziyun, was a man of Fugu in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jie, whose courtesy name was Ziyun, came from Fugu in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 以貲為牙將，有膽略，善騎射。

translations.literal: Through wealth he became a military adjutant; he had daring and strategy and was skilled in mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Through family wealth he became a military adjutant; he was bold and resourceful and skilled in mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 天聖中，西夏觀察使阿遇有子來歸。

translations.literal: In the Tiansheng era, the Xia Observation Commissioner A Yu had a son come over in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tiansheng era, the Xia Observation Commissioner A Yu had a son come over in surrender.

sentences.zh: 阿遇寇麟州，虜邊戶，約還子然後歸所虜。

translations.literal: A Yu raided Linzhou and captured frontier households, agreeing to return the son and then return those captured.
translations.idiomatic: A Yu raided Linzhou and captured frontier households, agreeing to return the son and then return those he had captured.

sentences.zh: 麟州還其子，而阿遇輒背約。

translations.literal: Linzhou returned the son, but A Yu immediately broke the agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Linzhou returned the son, but A Yu immediately broke the agreement.

sentences.zh: 安撫使遣岊詰問，岊徑造帳中，以逆順諭阿遇，阿遇語屈，留岊共食。

translations.literal: The pacification commissioner sent Jie to question him; Jie went straight into the tent and used right and wrong to admonish A Yu; A Yu was speechless and kept Jie to eat with him.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commissioner sent Jie to question him; Jie went straight into the tent and admonished A Yu with arguments of right and wrong; A Yu was speechless and kept Jie to eat with him.

sentences.zh: 阿遇袖佩刀，貫大臠啖岊，岊引吻就刀食肉，無所憚。

translations.literal: A Yu tucked a dagger in his sleeve, strung a large piece of meat, and fed Jie; Jie brought his lips to the blade to eat the meat without fear.
translations.idiomatic: A Yu tucked a dagger in his sleeve, strung a large piece of meat, and fed Jie; Jie brought his lips to the blade to eat the meat without fear.

sentences.zh: 阿遇復弦弓張鏃，指岊腹而彀，岊食不輟，神色自若。

translations.literal: A Yu again strung his bow and fitted an arrow, pointing at Jie's belly to draw the bow; Jie did not stop eating and his expression was as calm as ever.
translations.idiomatic: A Yu again strung his bow and fitted an arrow, pointing at Jie's belly to draw the bow; Jie did not stop eating and his expression remained calm.

sentences.zh: 阿遇撫岊背曰：「真男子也。

translations.literal: A Yu stroked Jie's back and said, "A true man indeed."
translations.idiomatic: A Yu stroked Jie's back and said, "A true man indeed."

sentences.zh: 」翌日，又與岊縱獵，雙兔起馬前，岊發兩矢，連斃二兔。

translations.literal: The next day he again went hunting with Jie; two hares rose before the horses, and Jie loosed two arrows and killed both in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he again went hunting with Jie; two hares rose before the horses, and Jie loosed two arrows and killed both in succession.

sentences.zh: 阿遇驚服，遺岊馬、橐駝，悉歸所虜。

translations.literal: A Yu was astonished and submitted; he gave Jie horses and camels and returned all those captured.
translations.idiomatic: A Yu was astonished and submitted; he gave Jie horses and camels and returned all those he had captured.

sentences.zh: 州將補為來遠砦主。

translations.literal: The prefectural commander appointed him master of Laiyuan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural commander appointed him master of Laiyuan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 手殺偽首領，奪其甲馬。

translations.literal: He personally killed a false chieftain and seized his armor and horse.
translations.idiomatic: He personally killed a false chieftain and seized his armor and horse.

sentences.zh: 時年十八，名動一軍。

translations.literal: At that time he was eighteen, and his name shook the whole army.
translations.idiomatic: At that time he was eighteen, and his name shook the whole army.

sentences.zh: 元昊犯鄜延，詔麟府進兵。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao invaded Yan Circuit, an edict ordered Lin and Fu to advance.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao invaded Yan Circuit, an edict ordered Lin and Fu to advance.

sentences.zh: 岊以都教練使從折繼閔破浪黃、黨兒兩族，射殺數十人，斬偽軍主敖保，以功補下班殿侍、三班差使。

translations.literal: Jie as Chief Training Officer followed Zhe Jimin against the Bolang Huang and Dang'er two tribes, shot and killed several tens, beheaded the false army commander Ao Bao, and for merit was appointed Acting Lower Team Palace Attendant and Third-Rank Envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Jie as Chief Training Officer followed Zhe Jimin against the Bolang Huang and Dang'er two tribes, shot and killed several tens, beheaded the false army commander Ao Bao, and for merit was appointed Acting Lower Team Palace Attendant and Third-Rank Envoy.

sentences.zh: 時敵騎方熾，中人促賜軍衣，至麟州，不得前。

translations.literal: At that time enemy horsemen were fierce; the court hurried to grant army clothing, but when it reached Linzhou it could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: At that time enemy horsemen were fierce; the court hurried to grant army clothing, but when it reached Linzhou it could not advance.

sentences.zh: 康德輿管勾軍馬司事，遣岊馳騎五十往護之。

translations.literal: Kang Deyu supervised military affairs of the army-horse office and sent Jie with fifty swift horsemen to escort it.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Deyu supervised military affairs of the army-horse office and sent Jie with fifty swift horsemen to escort it.

sentences.zh: 至青眉浪，遇賊接戰，流矢貫雙頰，岊拔矢，鬥愈力，奪馬十二匹而還。

translations.literal: At Qingmei Lang he met bandits in battle; a stray arrow pierced both cheeks; Jie pulled out the arrow, fought all the harder, seized twelve horses, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingmei Lang he met bandits in battle; a stray arrow pierced both cheeks; Jie pulled out the arrow, fought all the harder, seized twelve horses, and returned.

sentences.zh: 賊兵攻府州甚急，城西南隅庳下，賊將登，眾囂曰：「城破矣！

translations.literal: Bandit forces attacked Fuzhou very urgently; the southwest corner of the wall was low, and the bandits were about to climb; the crowd shouted, "The city is lost!"
translations.idiomatic: Bandit forces attacked Fuzhou very urgently; the southwest corner of the wall was low, and the bandits were about to climb; the crowd shouted, "The city is lost!"

sentences.zh: 」岊乘陴大呼搏賊，賊稍卻，飛矢中右目，下身被三創，晝夜督守。

translations.literal: Jie climbed the parapet and shouted as he fought the bandits; the bandits drew back slightly; a flying arrow struck his right eye, and below the waist he received three wounds, yet he supervised the defense day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Jie climbed the parapet and shouted as he fought the bandits; the bandits drew back slightly; a flying arrow struck his right eye, and below the waist he received three wounds, yet he supervised the defense day and night.

sentences.zh: 又帥死士開關，護州人汲於河，訖圍解，城中水不乏，以勞，遷右班殿直。

translations.literal: He also led death-defying troops to open the gate and escort the people of the prefecture to draw water from the river; when the siege was lifted the city did not lack water; for this labor he was transferred to Right Team Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He also led death-defying troops to open the gate and escort the people of the prefecture to draw water from the river; when the siege was lifted the city did not lack water; for this labor he was transferred to Right Team Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 然賊嘗往來邀奪饋運，以岊為麟、府州道路巡檢。

translations.literal: Yet the bandits often came and went seizing supply convoys, so Jie was made patrol inspector of the Lin and Fu route.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the bandits often came and went seizing supply convoys, so Jie was made patrol inspector of the Lin and Fu route.

sentences.zh: 至深柏堰，遇賊數千，分兵追擊，斬首百餘級，奪兵械、馬牛數百。

translations.literal: At Shenbai Weir he met several thousand bandits, divided his troops to pursue, beheaded more than a hundred, and seized weapons, horses, and cattle in the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: At Shenbai Weir he met several thousand bandits, divided his troops to pursue, beheaded more than a hundred, and seized weapons, horses, and cattle in the hundreds.

sentences.zh: 近郊民田，比秋成未敢獲，岊以計干張亢，得步卒九百人護之，大敗賊於龍門川。

translations.literal: Farmland near the suburbs — compared with autumn harvest they still did not dare reap — Jie by stratagem persuaded Zhang Kang to obtain nine hundred foot soldiers to guard it, and greatly defeated the bandits at Longmen River.
translations.idiomatic: Farmland near the suburbs — compared with autumn harvest they still did not dare reap — Jie by stratagem persuaded Zhang Kang to obtain nine hundred foot soldiers to guard it, and greatly defeated the bandits at Longmen River.

sentences.zh: 從諸將通麟州糧道，破賊於柏子砦。

translations.literal: He followed the various generals in opening the Linzhou grain route and defeated bandits at Baizi Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the various generals in opening the Linzhou grain route and defeated bandits at Baizi Stockade.

sentences.zh: 改左班殿直。

translations.literal: He was changed to Left Team Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Left Team Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 內侍宋永誠傳詔砦下，岊護永誠，遇賊三松嶺。

translations.literal: The inner attendant Song Yongcheng transmitted an edict below the stockade; Jie escorted Yongcheng and met bandits at Sansong Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant Song Yongcheng transmitted an edict below the stockade; Jie escorted Yongcheng and met bandits at Sansong Ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊以精騎挑戰，矢中岊臂，猶躍馬左右馳射，諸將乘勝而進，賊皆棄潰。

translations.literal: The bandits challenged with crack horsemen; an arrow struck Jie's arm, yet he still leaped on his horse and shot left and right; the generals pressed the victory and advanced, and the bandits all fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits challenged with crack horsemen; an arrow struck Jie's arm, yet he still leaped on his horse and shot left and right; the generals pressed the victory and advanced, and the bandits all fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 特改西頭供奉官，又遷內殿崇班。

translations.literal: He was specially changed to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting and again transferred to Inner Hall Honored Ban.
translations.idiomatic: He was specially changed to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting and again transferred to Inner Hall Honored Ban.

sentences.zh: 賊破豐州，岊與諸將一日數戰，破容州刺史耶布移守貴三砦，俘獲萬計。

translations.literal: When bandits broke Fengzhou, Jie and the various generals fought several battles in one day, broke the three stockades of Rongzhou prefect Yebu Yishougui, and captured or killed tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits broke Fengzhou, Jie and the various generals fought several battles in one day, broke the three stockades of Rongzhou prefect Yebu Yishougui, and captured or killed tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 遷禮賓副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of Ceremonial Reception.

sentences.zh: 明鎬在河東，以岢嵐軍當雲、朔路，奏岊為麟府路駐泊都監兼沿邊都巡檢使，駐岢嵐。

translations.literal: Ming Hao was in Hedong; as Yanjun Army stood on the Yun and Shuo route, he memorialized that Jie be Lin and Fu Circuit garrison superintendent with concurrent duty as frontier chief patrol inspector, stationed at Yanjun.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Hao was in Hedong; as Yanjun Army stood on the Yun and Shuo route, he memorialized that Jie be Lin and Fu Circuit garrison superintendent with concurrent duty as frontier chief patrol inspector, stationed at Yanjun.

sentences.zh: 張亢修並砦堡障，初議置安豐砦於石臺神，岊以為非要害之地，遂徙砦於生地骨堆以扼賊。

translations.literal: Zhang Kang repaired stockades and barriers at Bing; at first it was proposed to place Anfeng Stockade at Shitai Shen; Jie held that this was not a vital place and therefore moved the stockade to Shengdigudui to choke the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kang repaired stockades and barriers at Bing; at first it was proposed to place Anfeng Stockade at Shitai Shen; Jie held that this was not a vital place and therefore moved the stockade to Shengdigudui to choke the bandits.

sentences.zh: 左右親信咸曰：「擅易砦地可乎？

translations.literal: Close associates on left and right all said, "Can one arbitrarily change stockade ground?"
translations.idiomatic: Close associates on left and right all said, "Can one arbitrarily change stockade ground?"

sentences.zh: 」岊曰：「苟利國家，得罪無憾也。

translations.literal: Jie said, "If it benefits the state, I have no regret even if punished."
translations.idiomatic: Jie said, "If it benefits the state, I have no regret even if punished."

sentences.zh: 」卒易之。

translations.literal: In the end he changed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he changed it.

sentences.zh: 已而本道上言，左遷絳州兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Before long the circuit reported upward, and he was demoted to Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the circuit reported upward, and he was demoted to Infantry and Cavalry Commander of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二州未解嚴，復麟府駐泊都監，屯安豐。

translations.literal: The two prefectures had not yet lifted alert; he was again made Lin and Fu garrison superintendent, encamped at Anfeng.
translations.idiomatic: The two prefectures had not yet lifted alert; he was again made Lin and Fu garrison superintendent, encamped at Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 累遷洛苑使。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he became Luoyuan Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Through repeated promotions he became Luoyuan Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘗從數騎夜入羌中偵機事，既還，羌覺追之，岊隨羌疾馳，效羌語，與羌俱數里，乃得脫。

translations.literal: He once followed several horsemen at night into Qiang territory to spy out affairs; after he returned the Qiang noticed and pursued; Jie galloped with the Qiang at speed, imitated Qiang speech, and rode with them several li before he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: He once followed several horsemen at night into Qiang territory to spy out affairs; after he returned the Qiang noticed and pursued; Jie galloped with the Qiang at speed, imitated Qiang speech, and rode with them several li before he escaped.

sentences.zh: 前後數中流矢，創發臂間，卒。

translations.literal: He had been struck by stray arrows several times before; when an old wound opened in his arm he died.
translations.idiomatic: He had been struck by stray arrows several times before; when an old wound opened in his arm he died.

sentences.zh: 張君平

translations.literal: Zhang Junping
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Junping

sentences.zh: 張君平，字士衡，磁州滏陽人。

translations.literal: Zhang Junping, style name Shiheng, was a man of Fuyang in Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Junping, whose courtesy name was Shiheng, came from Fuyang in Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 以父承訓與契丹戰死，補三班差使殿侍、黔州指揮使。

translations.literal: Because his father Chengxun died fighting the Khitan, he was appointed Acting Third-Rank Envoy Palace Attendant and Commander of Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because his father Chengxun died fighting the Khitan, he was appointed Acting Third-Rank Envoy Palace Attendant and Commander of Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 獠兵屢入寇，君平引兵擊破之，以功遷奉職，除駐泊監押，徙容、白等州巡檢。

translations.literal: Liao troops repeatedly raided within the borders; Junping led troops to defeat them and for merit was transferred to Palace Service, removed as garrison superintendent, and transferred to patrol inspector of Rong, Bai, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Liao troops repeatedly raided within the borders; Junping led troops to defeat them and for merit was transferred to Palace Service, removed as garrison superintendent, and transferred to patrol inspector of Rong, Bai, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 又以捕賊功，遷右班殿直。

translations.literal: Again for merit in capturing bandits he was transferred to Right Team Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Again for merit in capturing bandits he was transferred to Right Team Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 謝德權薦君平河陰窖務，擢閤門祗候，管勾汴口。

translations.literal: Xie Dequan recommended Junping for the Heyin depot affairs; he was promoted to Chamberlain Attendant and supervised the Bian River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Dequan recommended Junping for the Heyin depot affairs; he was promoted to Chamberlain Attendant and supervised the Bian River mouth.

sentences.zh: 建言歲開汴口，當擇其地，得其地，則水湍駛而無留沙，歲可省功百餘萬。

translations.literal: He submitted a proposal that each year when the Bian mouth was opened, the place should be chosen; if the place is right, the water runs swift without leaving sand, and labor of more than a million can be saved each year.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a proposal that each year when the Bian mouth was opened, the place should be chosen carefully; if the right place was found, the water would run swift without depositing sand, and more than a million in labor could be saved each year.

sentences.zh: 又請沿河縣植榆柳，為令佐、使臣課最，及瘞汴河流屍，悉從其言。

translations.literal: He also requested that along the river counties elm and willow be planted, that this be made a criterion for assessing magistrates and envoys, and that corpses in the Bian River be buried — all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested that along the river counties elm and willow be planted, that this be made a criterion for assessing magistrates and envoys, and that corpses in the Bian River be buried — all were approved.

sentences.zh: 天聖初，議塞滑州決河，以君平習知河事，命以左侍禁簽書滑州事兼修河都監。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiansheng, when it was proposed to block the breached Yellow River at Huazhou, because Junping was skilled in river affairs he was ordered as Left Palace Attendant to sign Huazhou documents with concurrent duty as Chief River Repair Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiansheng, when it was proposed to block the breached Yellow River at Huazhou, because Junping was skilled in river affairs he was ordered as Left Palace Attendant to sign Huazhou documents with concurrent duty as Chief River Repair Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 既而河未塞，召同提點開封府界縣鎮公事。

translations.literal: Before long the river was not yet blocked, and he was summoned to jointly supervise Kaifeng prefectural boundary counties and market affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the river was not yet blocked, and he was summoned to jointly supervise Kaifeng prefectural boundary counties and market affairs.

sentences.zh: 以嘗護滑州堤有功，特遷內殿崇班。

translations.literal: Because he had once protected the Huazhou dike with merit, he was specially transferred to Inner Hall Honored Ban.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had once protected the Huazhou dike with merit, he was specially transferred to Inner Hall Honored Ban.

sentences.zh: 君平以京師數罹水災，請委官疏鑿近畿諸州古溝洫，久之，稍完，遂詔畿內及近畿州縣長吏，皆兼管勾溝洫河道。

translations.literal: Junping, because the capital repeatedly suffered flood disasters, requested that officials be delegated to dredge ancient canals and ditches in nearby prefectures; after a long time they were somewhat restored, and then an edict ordered magistrates of the capital region and nearby prefectures all to concurrently supervise canals, ditches, and river routes.
translations.idiomatic: Junping, because the capital repeatedly suffered flood disasters, requested that officials be delegated to dredge ancient canals and ditches in nearby prefectures; after a long time they were somewhat restored, and then an edict ordered magistrates of the capital region and nearby prefectures all to concurrently supervise canals, ditches, and river routes.

sentences.zh: 自畿至泗州，道路多群寇，君平請兩驛增置使臣，專主捕盜，而罷夾河巡檢，於是行者無患。

translations.literal: From the capital region to Sizhou the roads had many bandit gangs; Junping requested that two relay stations each add envoys devoted solely to capturing bandits, and that patrol inspectors along the river be abolished, and thereafter travelers had no worry.
translations.idiomatic: From the capital region to Sizhou the roads had many bandit gangs; Junping requested that two relay stations each add envoys devoted solely to capturing bandits, and that patrol inspectors along the river be abolished, and thereafter travelers had no worry.

sentences.zh: 復為滑州修河都監，遷供備庫副使。

translations.literal: He again became Huazhou Chief River Repair Superintendent and was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Supply Repository.
translations.idiomatic: He again became Huazhou Chief River Repair Superintendent and was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Supply Repository.

sentences.zh: 河平，改西作坊使，就遷鈐轄，卒。

translations.literal: When the river was pacified he was changed to Commissioner of the Western Arsenal and at the same time transferred to military commissioner; he died.
translations.idiomatic: When the river was pacified he was changed to Commissioner of the Western Arsenal and at the same time transferred to military commissioner; he died.

sentences.zh: 君平有吏材，尤明於水利，自議塞河，朝廷每訪以利害。

translations.literal: Junping had talent as an administrator and was especially clear on water conservancy; from the time of proposing to block the river, the court repeatedly consulted him on advantages and harms.
translations.idiomatic: Junping had talent as an administrator and was especially clear on water conservancy; from the time of proposing to block the river, the court repeatedly consulted him on advantages and harms.

sentences.zh: 河平，君平且死，論者惜之。

translations.literal: When the river was pacified, Junping was about to die; commentators regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: When the river was pacified, Junping was about to die; commentators regretted it.

sentences.zh: 錄三子官。

translations.literal: His three sons were enrolled in office.
translations.idiomatic: His three sons were enrolled in office.

sentences.zh: 子鞏，皇祐中，以尚書虞部員外郎為河陰發運判官，管勾汴口，嗣其父職云。

translations.literal: His son Gong, in the Huangyou era, as External Subdivision Director of the Ministry of Revenue served as Heyin transport judicial officer and supervised the Bian mouth, succeeding his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gong, in the Huangyou era, as External Subdivision Director of the Ministry of Revenue served as Heyin transport judicial officer and supervised the Bian mouth, succeeding his father's post.

sentences.zh: 論曰：孔子謂：「暴虎馮河，死而無悔者，不與也。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Confucius said, "He who rushes at a tiger or crosses a river, ready to die without regret — I will have nothing to do with him."
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Confucius said, "He who rushes at a tiger or crosses a river, ready to die without regret — I will have nothing to do with him."

sentences.zh: 」老氏曰：「佳兵者不祥。

translations.literal: Laozi said, "Fine weapons are inauspicious."
translations.idiomatic: Laozi said, "Fine weapons are inauspicious."

sentences.zh: 」景泰輩或起書生，或奮行伍，或出亡命，非有將率之材也。

translations.literal: Jing Tai and his ilk either rose from scholars, or sprang from the ranks, or came from fugitive lives; they did not possess the talent of generals and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Tai and his ilk either rose from scholars, or sprang from the ranks, or came from fugitive lives; they did not possess the talent of generals and commanders.

sentences.zh: 泰、信以區區之卒，嘗摧西夏之強鋒，頗知持重以制敵耳。

translations.literal: Tai and Xin with their meager troops once broke the sharp edge of the Western Xia, and somewhat knew how to hold steady to control the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Tai and Xin with their meager troops once broke the sharp edge of the Western Xia, and somewhat knew how to hold steady to control the enemy.

sentences.zh: 蔣、張輕肆自用，竟殞於烏合之寇。

translations.literal: Jiang and Zhang were rash and willful and in the end perished at the hands of a mob of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Zhang were rash and willful and in the end perished at the hands of a mob of bandits.

sentences.zh: 恩怵道元之勢，身啖虎口，守義不屈，猶足尚也。

translations.literal: En yielded to Daoyuan's power, yet his body entered the tiger's maw and he held to righteousness without bending — that is still worthy of respect.
translations.idiomatic: En yielded to Daoyuan's power, yet his body entered the tiger's maw and he held to righteousness without bending — that is still worthy of respect.

sentences.zh: 岊之驍勇，固非臨事而懼者。

translations.literal: Jie's fierce bravery was certainly not that of one who fears when facing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jie's fierce bravery was certainly not that of one who fears when facing affairs.

sentences.zh: 君平死戰之子，乃明習水利，以吏材稱，亦可謂善變矣。

translations.literal: Junping, son of one who died in battle, yet was clear on water conservancy and famed for administrative talent — this too may be called skill in adaptation.
translations.idiomatic: Junping, son of one who died in battle, yet was clear on water conservancy and famed for administrative talent — this too may be called skill in adaptation.

sentences.zh: 史方，字正臣，開封人。

translations.literal: Shi Fang, style name Zhengchen, was a man of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Fang, whose courtesy name was Zhengchen, came from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 應《周易》學究不中，補西第二班殿侍，再遷三班奉職，為潭、澧、鼎沿邊同巡檢，改右班殿直、閤門祗候。

translations.literal: He responded to the Zhouyi Erudite examination and was not selected, was appointed Western Second Team Palace Attendant, again transferred to Third-Rank Palace Service, served as joint frontier patrol inspector of Tan, Li, and Ding, and was changed to Right Team Palace Attendant and Chamberlain Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He sat for the Zhouyi Erudite examination and failed to pass, then received appointment as Western Second Team Palace Attendant; he was soon promoted to Third-Rank Palace Service and made joint frontier patrol inspector for Tan, Li, and Ding, before being reassigned as Right Team Palace Attendant and Chamberlain Attendant.

sentences.zh: 會澧州民訴下溪州蠻侵其土地，遣乘驛往視。

translations.literal: When people of Lizhou complained that the Xiaxi Prefecture barbarians were invading their lands, he was sent by relay horse to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: When Lizhou commoners petitioned that barbarians from Lower Stream Prefecture were encroaching on their territory, he was dispatched by courier to investigate.

sentences.zh: 自竹疏驛至申文崖，復地四百餘里，得所掠五百餘人，又置澧州、武口、楊泉、索溪四砦，以扼賊衝。

translations.literal: From Zhushu Post to Shenwen Cliff, he recovered more than four hundred li of land, retrieved more than five hundred people who had been seized, and further established four stockades at Lizhou, Wukou, Yangquan, and Suoxi to block the bandits' thrust.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling from Zhushu Relay Station to Shenwen Cliff, he reclaimed over four hundred li of territory, recovered more than five hundred captives, and built four stockades at Lizhou, Wukou, Yangquan, and Suoxi to choke the enemy's advance.

sentences.zh: 就知邵州，徙澧州，遷右待禁。

translations.literal: He was at the same time appointed acting prefect of Shaozhou, transferred to Lizhou, and promoted to Right Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was concurrently made acting prefect of Shaozhou, then moved to Lizzhou and promoted to Right Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 天禧中，下溪州蠻彭仕漢寇辰州，殺巡檢王文慶。

translations.literal: In the Tianxi era, Peng Shihan of the Lower Stream Prefecture barbarians raided Chenzhou and killed patrol inspector Wang Wenqing.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianxi period, Peng Shihan of the Lower Stream Prefecture tribes attacked Chenzhou and killed the patrol inspector Wang Wenqing.

sentences.zh: 方勒兵入溪洞討捕，降其黨李順同等八百餘人，誅其尤惡者社忽等十九人。

translations.literal: Fang mustered troops to enter the stream caves to hunt the bandits down, accepting the surrender of more than eight hundred followers including Li Shuntong, and executed nineteen of the worst offenders including Shehu.
translations.idiomatic: Fang led soldiers into the stream gorges to suppress the raiders, accepted the surrender of over eight hundred followers led by Li Shuntong, and put to death nineteen ringleaders including Shehu.

sentences.zh: 遷西頭供奉官、知辰州兼沿邊溪洞都巡檢使，修南、北江五砦，徙夔州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting, appointed prefect of Chenzhou with concurrent duty as chief frontier stream-cave patrol inspector, repaired five stockades on the South and North Rivers, and was transferred to Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting and made prefect of Chenzhou while also serving as chief frontier stream-cave patrol inspector; he rebuilt five stockades along the South and North Rivers before being transferred to Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 時富、順州蠻田彥晏寇施州，焚暗利砦。

translations.literal: The Shifu and Shunzhou barbarian Tian Yan'an raided Shizhou and burned Anli Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yan'an of the Shifu and Shunzhou tribes attacked Shizhou and burned Anli Stockade.

sentences.zh: 方領兵直抵富、順，蕩其巢穴，窮追彥晏至七女柵，降之。

translations.literal: Fang led troops straight to Shifu and Shun, swept their nests, pursued Yan'an relentlessly to Seven Maidens Stockade, and accepted his surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Fang marched directly on Shifu and Shun, destroyed their strongholds, chased Yan'an all the way to Seven Maidens Stockade, and compelled him to surrender.

sentences.zh: 遷內殿崇班，改內殿承制，奉使契丹，以供備庫副使知環州、環慶路兵馬都監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Inner Hall Honored Ban, changed to Inner Hall Artisan, sent on mission to the Khitan, and then served as Deputy Commissioner of the Supply Repository with concurrent posts as prefect of Huanzhou and frontier military superintendent of Huanqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Inner Hall Honored Ban, was reassigned as Inner Hall Artisan, served as envoy to the Khitan, and afterward held the posts of Deputy Commissioner of the Supply Repository, prefect of Huanzhou, and frontier military superintendent of Huanqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 先是，磨娟、浪壴、托校、拔新、兀二、兀三六族內寇，方諭以恩信，乃傳箭牽羊乞和。

translations.literal: Before this, the six tribes Mojuan, Langchang, Tuoxiao, Baxin, Wuer, and Wusan raided within the borders; Fang instructed them with grace and trust, and they then sent an arrow as message and led sheep to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the six tribes Mojuan, Langchang, Tuoxiao, Baxin, Wuer, and Wusan had raided the frontier; Fang won them over with kindness and good faith, whereupon they exchanged arrows and offered sheep in a plea for peace.

sentences.zh: 減禁兵五千，徙內地以省邊費。

translations.literal: He reduced the garrison troops by five thousand and moved them to the interior to save frontier expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He cut the frontier garrison by five thousand men and relocated them inland to reduce border costs.

sentences.zh: 徙慶州，遷禮賓使兼環慶路兵馬鈐轄，復知環州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Qingzhou, promoted to Commissioner of Ceremonies with concurrent duty as military commissioner of Huanqing Circuit, and again appointed prefect of Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to Qingzhou, promoted to Commissioner of Ceremonies while also serving as military commissioner of Huanqing Circuit, and again made prefect of Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，遷愛州刺史，為益州鈐轄，徙秦鳳路，遷西京作坊使，卒。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was transferred to prefect of Aizhou, served as military commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, moved to Qinfeng Circuit, was promoted to Commissioner of the Western Capital Arsenal, and died.
translations.idiomatic: A little over a year later he was made prefect of Aizhou, served as military commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, transferred to Qinfeng Circuit, rose to Commissioner of the Western Capital Arsenal, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 盧鑒，字正臣，金陵人。

translations.literal: Lu Jian, style name Zhengchen, was a man of Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jian, whose courtesy name was Zhengchen, came from Jinling.

sentences.zh: 累舉進士不中，授三班奉職、監坊州酒稅，以右班殿直為鄜延路走馬承受公事。

translations.literal: He repeatedly presented himself for the jinshi examination without success, was appointed Third-Rank Palace Service and supervisor of Fangzhou wine taxes, and as Right Team Palace Attendant served as mobile dispatch commissioner of the Yan-Yan Circuit.
