translations.idiomatic: Though he failed the jinshi examination several times, he received appointment as Third-Rank Palace Service and supervisor of Fangzhou wine taxes, and later served as Right Team Palace Attendant and mobile dispatch commissioner on the Yan-Yan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷寇邊，與總管王榮敗走之；

translations.literal: When Li Jiqian raided the frontier, together with commander-in-chief Wang Rong he defeated and drove him off;
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jiqian raided the border, he joined commander-in-chief Wang Rong in defeating and driving him back;

sentences.zh: 又與鈐轄張崇貴擊賊，焚其積聚，斬首級而還。

translations.literal: again together with military commissioner Zhang Chonggui he struck the bandits, burned their stores, beheaded the enemy, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: he later joined military commissioner Zhang Chonggui in attacking the rebels, burned their stockpiles, took heads, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 擢閤門祗候，為本路兵馬都監。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Chamberlain Attendant and made frontier military superintendent of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was elevated to Chamberlain Attendant and appointed frontier military superintendent of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 復出蕩族帳，獲羊牛萬計。

translations.literal: He again went out and swept the tribal encampments, capturing sheep and cattle numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He led another expedition against the tribal camps and seized tens of thousands of sheep and cattle.

sentences.zh: 徙鳳翔、秦隴、階、成等州提點賊盜公事，尋為都巡檢使，徙利州都監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to supervise bandit affairs in Fengxiang, Qinlong, Jie, Cheng, and other prefectures, soon became chief patrol inspector, and was transferred to military superintendent of Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned to supervise bandit suppression in Fengxiang, Qinlong, Jie, Cheng, and other prefectures, soon became chief patrol inspector, and then was made military superintendent of Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 初，繼遷聲言石隕帳前，有文曰：「天誡爾勿為中國患。

translations.literal: At first, Jiqian spread word that before his tent a stone had fallen, with writing saying, "Heaven warns you not to become an affliction to China.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Jiqian claimed that a stone had fallen before his tent bearing the inscription, "Heaven warns you not to become a scourge upon China.

sentences.zh: 」鑒時為承受，入奏事，真宗問之，鑒曰：「此詐為之以欺朝廷也，宜益為備。

translations.literal: " Jian was then dispatch commissioner; entering to report affairs, Zhenzong asked about it, and Jian said, "This was fabricated to deceive the court; preparations should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time Jian served as dispatch commissioner; when he entered court to report, Zhenzong questioned him, and Jian replied, "This was a forgery meant to mislead the court. Defenses should be strengthened.

sentences.zh: 」至是，繼遷陷靈武，帝思其言，特遷右侍禁、知儀州。

translations.literal: " By this time Jiqian had taken Lingwu; the Emperor remembered his words and specially transferred him to Right Palace Guard and prefect of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: " By then Jiqian had captured Lingwu; the Emperor recalled his warning and specially promoted him to Right Palace Guard and prefect of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 州有制勝關，最號險要，繼遷欲乘虛襲取之，放言將由此大入。

translations.literal: The prefecture had Zhisheng Pass, most famed as strategically vital; Jiqian wished to seize it by surprise and spread word that he would make a major incursion by this route.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture held Zhisheng Pass, renowned as the most critical strongpoint; Jiqian planned to strike it when defenses were weak and publicly declared that he would launch a major invasion through it.

sentences.zh: 諜者以告。

translations.literal: Spies reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence agents brought word of it.

sentences.zh: 有詔徙老幼、芻粟於內地。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the old and young, fodder, and grain moved to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the evacuation of the aged and young, along with fodder and grain supplies, to the interior.

sentences.zh: 鑒曰：「此奸謀也，且示虜弱，搖民心，臣不敢奉詔。

translations.literal: Jian said, "This is a treacherous stratagem; moreover it shows the barbarians our weakness and shakes the people's hearts — your servant dares not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Jian said, "This is an enemy ruse; it would also advertise weakness to the barbarians and unsettle the people. I dare not carry out this order.

sentences.zh: 」卒不徙，已而賊亦不至。

translations.literal: " In the end he did not move them, and before long the bandits also did not come.
translations.idiomatic: " He ultimately refused to evacuate them, and soon afterward the enemy never appeared.

sentences.zh: 再遷西頭供奉官、知利州。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting and appointed prefect of Lizzhou.

sentences.zh: 會歲饑，以便宜發倉粟振民。

translations.literal: When famine struck, he used discretionary authority to open granaries and relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: When the year brought famine, he exercised emergency authority to distribute grain from the state granaries and relieve the populace.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，民請留，詔留一年。

translations.literal: When his term expired the people requested that he remain, and an edict kept him for one year.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended the people petitioned to retain him, and the throne ordered him to stay another year.

sentences.zh: 提點河東路刑獄，歷知保州、廣信軍、原州，就為環慶路都監兼知慶州，徙環州。

translations.literal: He supervised criminal cases on the Hedong Circuit, successively served as prefect of Baozhou, Guangxin Army, and Yuanzhou, was at the same time frontier military superintendent of Huanqing Circuit with concurrent prefect of Qingzhou, and was transferred to Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as judicial intendant of Hedong Circuit and successively governed Baozhou, Guangxin Army, and Yuanzhou; he was then made frontier military superintendent of Huanqing Circuit while also serving as prefect of Qingzhou, and afterward transferred to Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 平磨媚族於合道鎮。

translations.literal: He pacified the Momei tribe at Hedao Town.
translations.idiomatic: He subdued the Momei tribe at Hedao Town.

sentences.zh: 坐事徙知丹州。

translations.literal: Because of an offense he was transferred and made prefect of Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After being implicated in a case, he was demoted to prefect of Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 累遷西京左藏庫使、恩州刺史，為環慶路鈐轄兼知環州，改西上閤門使、秦州，卒。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he rose to Commissioner of the Western Capital Left Treasury and prefect of Enzhou, served as military commissioner of Huanqing Circuit with concurrent prefect of Huanzhou, was changed to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant and prefect of Qinzhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to Commissioner of the Western Capital Left Treasury and prefect of Enzhou, served as military commissioner of Huanqing Circuit while also governing Huanzhou, was reassigned as Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant and prefect of Qinzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 李渭，字師望，其先西河人，後家河陽。

translations.literal: Li Wei, style name Shiwang, his ancestors were men of Xihe, and later the family settled in Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei, whose courtesy name was Shiwang, traced his ancestry to Xihe, though his family later made its home in Heyang.

sentences.zh: 進士起家，為臨潁縣主簿，累官至太常博士。

translations.literal: He entered office through the jinshi and served as chief clerk of Linying County, rising through repeated promotions to Doctor of the Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi degree launched his career; he served as chief clerk of Linying County and rose through successive posts to Doctor of the Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 會河決滑州，天聖初，上治河十策，參知政事魯宗道奉詔行河。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River breached at Huazhou, at the beginning of Tiansheng he submitted ten policies for governing the river, and Vice Grand Councilor Lu Zongdao was ordered by edict to oversee river works.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yellow River broke through at Huazhou, at the start of the Tiansheng era he submitted ten proposals for river control, and Vice Grand Councilor Lu Zongdao received orders to direct the river project.

sentences.zh: 奏渭換北作坊副使，與張君平並為修河都監。

translations.literal: It was memorialized that Wei be transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal and serve jointly with Zhang Junping as Chief River Repair Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: A memorial recommended transferring Wei to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Arsenal and appointing him, together with Zhang Junping, as Chief River Repair Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 未幾皆罷，以渭為鄆州兵馬都監，徙知憲州，又知鳳州兼階、成州鈐轄。

translations.literal: Before long both were dismissed; Wei was made frontier military superintendent of Yanzhou, transferred to govern Xianzhou, and again appointed prefect of Fengzhou with concurrent military commissioner of Jie and Cheng prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Soon both men were removed from office; Wei was made frontier military superintendent of Yanzhou, transferred to Xianzhou, and later appointed prefect of Fengzhou while also serving as military commissioner of Jie and Cheng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 初，屬戶寇陷階州沙灘砦，渭至，詰所以然者，乃都校趙釗擾之，奏流釗道州，以恩信諭酋帥，復其砦。

translations.literal: At first dependent households raided and took Shaztan Stockade in Jiezhou; when Wei arrived he questioned why this had happened, and it turned out that company commander Zhao Zhao had provoked them; he memorialized to banish Zhao to Daozhou, instructed the chieftains with grace and trust, and restored the stockade.
translations.idiomatic: When dependent households attacked and captured Shaztan Stockade in Jiezhou, Wei investigated the cause and found that company commander Zhao Zhao had provoked them; he memorialized to exile Zhao to Daozhou, won over the tribal leaders through kindness and trust, and recovered the stockade.

sentences.zh: 遷軍器庫副使，歷知原、環、慶三州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Armory and successively served as prefect of Yuan, Huan, and Qing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of the Armory and successively governed Yuan, Huan, and Qing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 時詔舉勇略任邊者，李諮以渭應詔。

translations.literal: At the time an edict called for recommending men of courage and strategy fit for frontier duty, and Li Zi recommended Wei in response to the edict.
translations.idiomatic: When the throne ordered recommendations of bold and capable men for frontier service, Li Zi nominated Wei in answer to the edict.

sentences.zh: 徙益利路兵馬鈐轄，領惠州刺史，遷東八作使，擢西上閤門使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of Yili Circuit, held the post of prefect of Huizhou, was promoted to Commissioner of the Eastern Eight Workshops, and elevated to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was made military commissioner of Yili Circuit, served concurrently as prefect of Huizhou, rose to Commissioner of the Eastern Eight Workshops, and was elevated to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant.

sentences.zh: 徙鄜延路，再遷四方館使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Yan-Yan Circuit and again promoted to Commissioner of the Four Directions Hostel.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned to the Yan-Yan Circuit and later promoted to Commissioner of the Four Directions Hostel.

sentences.zh: 王果，字仲武，深州饒陽人。

translations.literal: Wang Guo, style name Zhongwu, was a man of Raoyang in Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Guo, whose courtesy name was Zhongwu, came from Raoyang in Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 舉明法。

translations.literal: He passed the Mingfa examination.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his degree through the Mingfa examination.

sentences.zh: 歷大理寺詳斷官，遷光祿寺丞，以太子右贊善大夫為審刑院詳議官，遷殿中丞。

translations.literal: He served as detailed adjudication officer of the Court of Judicial Review, was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, served as detailed deliberation officer of the Court of Judicial Review as Right Supporter of the Heir Apparent, and was transferred to Palace Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: He served as detailed adjudication officer in the Court of Judicial Review, rose to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, became a detailed deliberation officer of the Court of Judicial Review while holding the title Right Supporter of the Heir Apparent, and was promoted to Palace Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 奏邊策，試舍人院，改衣庫副使、知永寧軍，更尚食使、知保州。

translations.literal: He submitted frontier strategies, was tested at the Drafting Academy, was changed to Deputy Commissioner of the Wardrobe Repository and prefect of Yongning Army, and again made Commissioner of Imperial Food and prefect of Baozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted frontier strategies, passed examination at the Drafting Academy, was reassigned as Deputy Commissioner of the Wardrobe Repository and prefect of Yongning Army, and later made Commissioner of Imperial Food and prefect of Baozhou.

sentences.zh: 契丹謀致書求關南地，使未至，果購諜者先得其稿，奏之，擢領賀州刺史兼高陽關路兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: The Khitan planned to send a letter requesting the Guannan territory; before the envoy arrived, Guo purchased a spy who first obtained the draft and memorialized it; he was promoted to hold the post of prefect of Hezhou with concurrent military commissioner of the Gaoyang Pass Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan planned to send a letter demanding the Guannan territories; before their envoy arrived, Guo paid an informant who obtained the draft first and reported it to the throne; he was promoted to prefect of Hezhou with concurrent command as military commissioner of the Gaoyang Pass Circuit.

sentences.zh: 中官楊懷敏領沿邊屯田事，大廣塘水，邊臣莫敢言，果獨抗辨水侵民田，無益邊備。

translations.literal: The inner attendant Yang Huaimin supervised frontier garrison-farming affairs and greatly expanded the pond-marsh waters; frontier officials dared not speak, but Guo alone argued against it, saying the water encroached on the people's fields and did not benefit frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Yang Huaimin oversaw frontier garrison farming and greatly expanded the pond-marsh system; no frontier official dared object, but Guo alone protested that the flooding harmed civilian fields and did nothing for border defense.

sentences.zh: 懷敏怒，訴果以不法，左遷青州兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Huaimin was angry and accused Guo of illegal conduct; Guo was demoted to frontier military superintendent of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Huaimin charged Guo with misconduct, and Guo was demoted to frontier military superintendent of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 歷永興軍兵馬鈐轄、知隴州。

translations.literal: He successively served as military commissioner of Yongxing Army and prefect of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as military commissioner of Yongxing Army and as prefect of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 俄詔還，遷皇城使、河北沿邊安撫副使，徙知定州兼真定路兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: Before long an edict recalled him; he was transferred to Commissioner of the Imperial City and Vice Commissioner for Frontier Pacification of Hebei, and was moved to govern Dingzhou with concurrent military commissioner of the Zhending Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled by edict, promoted to Commissioner of the Imperial City and Vice Commissioner for Frontier Pacification of Hebei, and transferred to Dingzhou while also serving as military commissioner of the Zhending Circuit.

sentences.zh: 叛卒據保州，果坐多傷士眾，徙知密州。

translations.literal: When mutinous soldiers held Baozhou, Guo was blamed for excessive casualties among the troops and was transferred to govern Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When rebel troops seized Baozhou, Guo was held responsible for heavy troop losses and was reassigned as prefect of Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 又知忻州、鄜州，權秦鳳路兵馬總管，遷西上閤門使，徙知滄州，卒。

translations.literal: He again served as prefect of Xinzhou and Yanzhou, acted as commander-in-chief of Qinfeng Circuit infantry and cavalry, was transferred to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant, was moved to govern Cangzhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He later governed Xinzhou and Yanzhou, served as acting commander-in-chief of Qinfeng Circuit infantry and cavalry, rose to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant, was transferred to Cangzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 郭諮，字仲謀，趙州平棘人。

translations.literal: Guo Zi, style name Zhongmou, was a man of Pingji in Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zi, whose courtesy name was Zhongmou, came from Pingji in Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 八歲始能言，聰敏過人。

translations.literal: He could speak only from the age of eight and was unusually quick-witted.
translations.idiomatic: He did not speak until he was eight, yet his intelligence far surpassed others.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，歷通利軍司理參軍、中牟縣主簿，改大理寺丞、知濟陰縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, served successively as judicial adjutant of Tongli Army and chief clerk of Zhongmou County, and was changed to Court of Judicial Review Director and prefect of Jiyin County.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi graduate, he served successively as judicial adjutant of Tongli Army and chief clerk of Zhongmou County before being appointed Court of Judicial Review Director and prefect of Jiyin County.

sentences.zh: 建言：「澶、滑堤狹，無以殺大河之怒，故漢以來河決多在澶、滑。

translations.literal: He submitted a proposal: "The dikes at Dan and Hua are narrow and cannot tame the Yellow River's fury, so since Han times breaches have mostly occurred at Dan and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a proposal: "The levees at Dan and Hua are too narrow to contain the Yellow River's force, which is why most breaches since Han times have occurred there.

sentences.zh: 且黎陽九河之原，今若引河出汶子山下，穿金堤，與橫壟合，以達於海，則害可息。

translations.literal: Moreover Liyang is the source of the Nine Rivers; if the river were now diverted out below Wenzishan, pierced the Golden Dike, and joined the Henglong to reach the sea, the harm could cease.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Liyang lies at the headwaters of the Nine Rivers; if the river were diverted below Wenzishan, cut through the Golden Dike, and joined the Henglong channel to reach the sea, the flooding could be stopped.

sentences.zh: 」詔本道使者共議，弗合。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the circuit envoys to discuss it together, but they could not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne ordered circuit envoys to confer on the plan, but they failed to reach agreement.

sentences.zh: 部夫坐小法，監通利軍稅。

translations.literal: For supervising corvée labor he violated a minor regulation and was made supervisor of Tongli Army taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Because he breached a minor regulation while supervising corvée labor, he was demoted to supervisor of Tongli Army taxes.

sentences.zh: 洺州肥鄉縣田賦不平，歲久莫治，轉運使楊偕遣諮攝令以往。

translations.literal: The field taxes of Feixiang County in Bozhou were unequal, and for years no one had remedied it; transport commissioner Yang Xie sent Zi as acting magistrate to go there.
translations.idiomatic: Land-tax assessments in Feixiang County, Bozhou, had long been unfair and gone unreformed; transport commissioner Yang Xie dispatched Zi as acting magistrate to set matters right.

sentences.zh: 既至，閉閣數日，以千步方田法四出量括，遂得其數，除無地之租者四百家，正無租之地者百家，收逋賦八十萬，流民乃復，偕奏其才，遷殿中丞、知館陶縣。

translations.literal: Once he arrived he closed his office for several days, then sent out surveyors in four directions using the thousand-paces square-field method, and thus obtained the figures; he removed rent from four hundred households without land, corrected one hundred parcels of land without rent, collected eight hundred thousand in overdue taxes, and the displaced people returned; Xie memorialized his talent, and he was transferred to Palace Secretariat Director and prefect of Guantao County.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he shut himself in for several days, then dispatched surveyors in all directions using the thousand-paces square-field method until the true figures were established; he canceled rent for four hundred landless households, corrected one hundred untaxed parcels, recovered eight hundred thousand in arrears, and displaced people returned home; Xie praised his ability, and Zi was promoted to Palace Secretariat Director and prefect of Guantao County.

sentences.zh: 康定西征，諮上戰略，獻《拒馬槍陣法》，其制利山川險隘，以騎士試上前，擢通判鎮戎軍，募兵教習。

translations.literal: In the Kangding western campaign Zi submitted strategy, presented the Horse-Rejecting Spear Formation Method, whose design suited mountain and river defiles; he demonstrated it before the throne with horsemen and was promoted to vice prefect of Zhenrong Army to recruit and drill troops.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangding western expedition Zi submitted battle plans and presented his Horse-Rejecting Spear Formation Method, designed for rugged terrain; after demonstrating it with cavalry before the throne, he was promoted to vice prefect of Zhenrong Army to recruit and train soldiers.

sentences.zh: 會三司議均稅法，知諫院歐陽修言，惟諮方田法簡而易行，詔諮與孫琳均蔡州上蔡縣稅。

translations.literal: When the Three Departments discussed the equal-tax method, Remonstrance Academy director Ouyang Xiu said that only Zi's square-field method was simple and easy to implement; an edict ordered Zi and Sun Lin to equalize taxes in Shangcai County, Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Departments debated tax equalization, Remonstrance Academy director Ouyang Xiu declared that only Zi's square-field method was simple and practical; the throne ordered Zi and Sun Lin to equalize taxes in Shangcai County, Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 以母憂免官。

translations.literal: Because of mourning for his mother he was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 用宰相呂夷簡薦，起為崇儀副使、提舉黃御河堤岸。

translations.literal: On Grand Councilor Lü Yijian's recommendation he was recalled as Deputy Commissioner of Honored Ceremonies and supervisor of the Yellow Imperial River embankments.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended by Grand Councilor Lü Yijian, he was recalled to serve as Deputy Commissioner of Honored Ceremonies and supervisor of the Yellow Imperial River embankments.

sentences.zh: 時富弼使契丹，諮入對，陳大水禦戎之要。

translations.literal: At the time Fu Bi was envoy to the Khitan; Zi entered audience and set forth the essentials of using great floods to defend against barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: While Fu Bi served as envoy to the Khitan, Zi was received in audience and explained how massive flooding could be used to check barbarian incursions.

sentences.zh: 詔與楊懷敏、鄧保信行河，其議「決黎陽大河，下與胡蘆、滹沱、後唐河以注塘泊，混界河，使東北抵於海，上溢鸛鵲陂，下注北當城，南視塘泊，界截虜疆，東至海口，西接保塞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him together with Yang Huaimin and Deng Baoxin to oversee the river; their plan was "to breach the great river at Liyang, send it down to join the Hulu, Hutuo, and Later Tang rivers to feed the pond-marshes, mingle with the boundary river, make it reach northeast to the sea, overflow upward into Guanque Marsh, flow down north of Dangcheng, look south upon the pond-marshes, cut off the barbarian frontier, extend east to the sea mouth, and connect west to Baosai.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered him, together with Yang Huaimin and Deng Baoxin, to direct the river project according to a plan to breach the Yellow River at Liyang, channel it into the Hulu, Hutuo, and Later Tang rivers to fill the pond-marsh system, merge with the boundary river, drive it northeast to the sea, flood Guanque Marsh upstream, pour down north of Dangcheng, form a southern barrier of pond-marshes, block the barbarian frontier, reach east to the sea mouth, and link west to Baosai.

sentences.zh: 惟保塞正西四十里，水不可到，請立堡砦，以兵戍之。

translations.literal: Only forty li due west of Baosai the water could not reach; he requested that fort stockades be established and garrisoned with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Only forty li directly west of Baosai could the water not reach; he asked that fortified stockades be built there and manned with troops.

sentences.zh: 」詔儲用興役，會契丹約和而止。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered funds stored for the project, but when the Khitan made peace it was halted.
translations.idiomatic: " Funds were set aside for the work by edict, but the project stopped when peace was concluded with the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 知丹、利二州。

translations.literal: He served as prefect of Dan and Li prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He governed Dan and Li prefectures.

sentences.zh: 王則叛，文彥博薦諮知冀州，運糧助攻討。

translations.literal: When Wang Ze rebelled, Wen Yanbo recommended Zi as prefect of Jizhou to transport grain and assist in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: During Wang Ze's rebellion, Wen Yanbo recommended Zi as prefect of Jizhou to supply grain and join the suppression campaign.

sentences.zh: 賊平，徙忻州，開渭渠，導汾水，興水利，置屯田。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified he was transferred to Xinzhou, opened the Wei Canal, diverted the Fen River, developed water conservancy, and established garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were crushed he was moved to Xinzhou, where he dug the Wei Canal, diverted the Fen River, developed irrigation works, and established garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 轉運使任顓言諮有巧思，自為兵械皆可用。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Ren Hao said Zi had ingenious ideas and that every weapon he devised himself was usable.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Ren Hao reported that Zi was ingenious and that every military device he designed proved practical.

sentences.zh: 詔以所作刻漏、圓楯、獨轅弩、生皮甲來上，帝頗嘉之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the clepsydra, round shield, single-shaft crossbow, and raw-hide armor he had made sent up; the Emperor was quite pleased.
translations.idiomatic: By edict the clepsydra, round shield, single-shaft crossbow, and raw-hide armor he had invented were sent to court, and the Emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 除益州路兵馬鈐轄，累遷英州刺史，後為契丹祭奠副使、知汾州。

translations.literal: He was appointed military commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, rose through repeated promotions to prefect of Yingzhou, and later served as deputy envoy for Khitan condolence rites and prefect of Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made military commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, rose through successive promotions to prefect of Yingzhou, and later served as deputy condolence envoy to the Khitan while governing Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 未行，言獨轅弩可試，改鄜延路兵馬鈐轄，許置弩五百，募士兵教之。

translations.literal: Before he departed he said the single-shaft crossbow could be tested; he was changed to military commissioner of the Yan-Yan Circuit, permitted to deploy five hundred crossbows, and ordered to recruit local soldiers to train with them.
translations.idiomatic: Before setting out he argued that the single-shaft crossbow should be field-tested; he was reassigned as military commissioner of the Yan-Yan Circuit, authorized to deploy five hundred of the weapons, and told to recruit local troops to train with them.

sentences.zh: 既成，經略使夏安期言其便，詔立獨轅弩軍。

translations.literal: When this was accomplished, frontier commissioner Xia Anqi said it was advantageous, and an edict established a Single-Shaft Crossbow Corps.
translations.idiomatic: Once the corps was ready, frontier commissioner Xia Anqi reported its effectiveness, and the throne ordered the formation of a Single-Shaft Crossbow Corps.

sentences.zh: 以西上閤門使知潞州。

translations.literal: He was made Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant and prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant and prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 言懷、保二郡旁山，可以植稻；

translations.literal: He said that in Huai and Bao, two prefectures beside mountains, rice could be planted;
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Huai and Bao, two mountainous prefectures, were suited to rice cultivation;

sentences.zh: 定武唐河抵瀛、莫間，可興水田。

translations.literal: from Dingwu along the Tang River to between Ying and Mo, paddy fields could be developed.
translations.idiomatic: and that from Dingwu along the Tang River to the region between Ying and Mo, irrigated fields could be opened.

sentences.zh: 又作鹿角車、陷馬槍，請廣獨轅弩於他道。

translations.literal: He also devised stag-antler carts and horse-trapping spears, and requested that single-shaft crossbows be extended to other routes.
translations.idiomatic: He also invented stag-antler carts and horse-trapping spears, and asked that single-shaft crossbows be deployed on other frontier routes as well.

sentences.zh: 詔諮置弩千分給幷、潞，諮因上疏曰：「臣自冠武弁，未嘗一日不思禦戎之計。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zi to deploy one thousand crossbows divided between Bing and Lu; Zi then submitted a memorial saying, "Your servant, from the time he first donned armor, has not passed a single day without thinking of plans to defend against barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Zi to deploy one thousand crossbows, divided between Bing and Lu; he then submitted a memorial saying, "Since I first took up arms, not a day has passed when I did not devise plans to check the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 頃使契丹，觀幽燕地方不及三百里，無十萬人一年之費，且烏合之眾，非二十萬不敢舉。

translations.literal: Recently on mission to the Khitan I observed that the Youyan region is less than three hundred li across, lacks supplies for one hundred thousand men for a year, and moreover its forces are a mob — without two hundred thousand they dare not act.
translations.idiomatic: On a recent mission to the Khitan I saw that the Youyan region spans less than three hundred li, cannot sustain a hundred thousand men for a year, and fields a rabble that will not march without two hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 若以術制之，使舉不得利，居無以給，不逾數年，必棄幽州而遁。

translations.literal: If by stratagem they are controlled so that when they act they gain no advantage and when they stay they cannot be supplied, within a few years they will surely abandon Youzhou and flee.
translations.idiomatic: If we use strategy to deny them profit in attack and sustenance in occupation, within a few years they will surely abandon Youzhou and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 臣慶曆初經畫河北大水，界斷敵疆，乃其術也。

translations.literal: Your servant, at the beginning of Qingli, planned the great floods of Hebei to cut off the enemy frontier — that is precisely this stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qingli era I designed the great Hebei floodworks to block the enemy frontier — that is exactly such a strategy.

sentences.zh: 臣所創車弩可以破堅甲，制奔衝，若多設之，助以大水，取幽薊如探囊中物爾。」

translations.literal: The cart-mounted crossbows your servant devised can break hard armor and check charging assaults; if many are deployed and aided by great floods, taking You and Ji would be like reaching into a bag."
translations.idiomatic: The cart-mounted crossbows I have devised can pierce heavy armor and stop cavalry charges; deployed in numbers and combined with flooding, seizing You and Ji would be as easy as taking something from a pouch."

sentences.zh: 時三司議均田租，召還，諮陳均括之法四十條。

translations.literal: At the time the Three Departments were discussing equalization of field rents; he was recalled and Zi set forth forty articles on the equal-survey method.
translations.idiomatic: While the Three Departments debated equalizing field rents, he was recalled and presented forty articles on his equal-survey method.

sentences.zh: 復上《平燕議》曰：「契丹之地，自瓦橋至古北口，地狹民少。

translations.literal: He again submitted the Pacify Yan Discourse, saying, "Khitan territory from Waqiao to Gubeikou is narrow in land and sparse in people.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted again his Discourse on Pacifying Yan, arguing, "From Waqiao to Gubeikou the Khitan lands are cramped and thinly populated.

sentences.zh: 自古北口至中原，屬奚、契丹，自中原至慶州，道旁才七百餘家。

translations.literal: From Gubeikou to the Central Plains the region belongs to the Xi and Khitan; from the Central Plains to Qingzhou there are only a little more than seven hundred households along the road.
translations.idiomatic: From Gubeikou to the Central Plains the country belongs to the Xi and Khitan; from the Central Plains to Qingzhou there are barely seven hundred households along the route.

sentences.zh: 蓋契丹疆土雖廣，人馬至少，儻或南牧，必率高麗、渤海、黑水、女真、室韋等國會戰，其來既遠，其糧匱乏。

translations.literal: Although Khitan territory is broad, its men and horses are few; if they should drive south to pasture, they must surely summon Korea, Bohai, Heishui, Jurchen, Shiwen, and other states to join battle — their march is distant and their grain exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Though Khitan territory is vast, its manpower and horses are scant; should they raid south, they must rally Korea, Bohai, Heishui, Jurchen, Shiwen, and other peoples — their march is long and their supplies will run out.

sentences.zh: 臣聞以近待遠，以佚待勞，以飽待饑，用兵之善計。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that to meet the distant with the near, to meet the weary with the rested, and to meet the hungry with the fed — these are the fine stratagems of warfare.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that meeting the distant with the near, the weary with the rested, and the hungry with the well-fed — these are the supreme principles of war.

sentences.zh: 又聞得敵自至者勝，先據便地者佚。

translations.literal: Your servant has also heard that victory goes to him who lets the enemy come of himself, and rest goes to him who first occupies advantageous ground.
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that he wins who lets the enemy come to him, and he rests who holds favorable ground first.

sentences.zh: 以臣所見，請舉慶曆之策，合眾河於塘泊之北界，以限戎馬，然後以景德故事，頓兵自守。

translations.literal: In your servant's view, I request that the Qingli policy be adopted — joining the rivers north of the pond-marshes to limit barbarian horses, and then following the Jingde precedent, massing troops for self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: In my view, we should revive the Qingli policy: combine the rivers north of the pond-marsh line to block barbarian cavalry, then follow the Jingde precedent and concentrate troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 步卒十二萬，騎卒三萬，強壯三萬，歲計糧餉百八十三萬六千斛。

translations.literal: Foot soldiers one hundred twenty thousand, horsemen thirty thousand, strong reserves thirty thousand — yearly grain rations are calculated at one million eight hundred thirty-six thousand six hundred hu.
translations.idiomatic: This would require one hundred twenty thousand foot soldiers, thirty thousand cavalry, and thirty thousand strong reserves, with annual grain rations estimated at one million eight hundred thirty-six thousand six hundred hu.

sentences.zh: 又傍河郡邑，可以水運以給保州。

translations.literal: Moreover the prefectures and towns beside the river can supply Baozhou by water transport.
translations.idiomatic: Riverine prefectures and towns could also supply Baozhou by water transport.

sentences.zh: 然後以拒馬車三千，陷馬槍千五百，獨轅弩三萬，分選五將，臣可以備其一，來則戰，去則勿追。

translations.literal: Then take three thousand horse-rejecting carts, fifteen hundred horse-trapping spears, and thirty thousand single-shaft crossbows; select five generals, and your servant can be one of them — when they come, fight; when they go, do not pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Then deploy three thousand horse-rejecting carts, fifteen hundred horse-trapping spears, and thirty thousand single-shaft crossbows; choose five generals, of whom I could serve as one — fight when the enemy comes, but do not pursue when they withdraw.

sentences.zh: 幽州糧儲既少，敵不可久留，不半年間，當遁沙漠。

translations.literal: Youzhou has little grain stored; the enemy cannot stay long — within half a year they will flee to the desert.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou holds little grain; the enemy cannot remain long — within half a year they will withdraw into the desert.

sentences.zh: 則進兵斷古北口，砦松亭關，傳檄幽薊，燕南自定。

translations.literal: Then advance to cut Gubeikou, fortify Songting Pass, issue proclamations to You and Ji, and south of Yan will settle itself.
translations.idiomatic: Then march to block Gubeikou, garrison Songting Pass, send proclamations to You and Ji, and the lands south of Yan will submit of themselves.

sentences.zh: 且彼之所恃者，惟馬而已。

translations.literal: Moreover, what they rely on is horses alone.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, what they rely on is cavalry alone.

sentences.zh: 但能多方致力，使馬不獲伸用，則敵可破，幽燕可取。

translations.literal: If we exert ourselves in many ways so that horses cannot be put to use, the enemy can be broken and You and Yan taken.
translations.idiomatic: If we apply ourselves on many fronts so that their horses cannot be brought into play, the enemy can be broken and You and Yan recovered.

sentences.zh: 」帝壯其言，詔置獨轅弩二萬，同提舉百司及南北作坊，以完軍器。

translations.literal: The Emperor was impressed by his words and ordered twenty thousand single-shaft crossbows placed, with joint oversight by the hundred offices and the northern and southern workshops to complete military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was impressed by his argument and ordered twenty thousand single-shaft crossbows deployed, with joint oversight by the hundred offices and the northern and southern workshops to complete the army's equipment.

sentences.zh: 諮嘗謂作汴乘索河三十六陂之流，危京師，請自鞏西山七里店孤柏嶺下鑿七十里，導洛入汴，可以四時行運。

translations.literal: Zi once said that making the Bian River carry the waters of the Suo River and thirty-six ponds endangered the capital; he requested cutting seventy li from Qili Store at Gushan west of Gong through Gubai Ridge to divert the Luo into the Bian, enabling transport in all four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Zi once argued that making the Bian River carry the Suo River and the waters of thirty-six ponds endangered the capital; he asked to cut seventy li from Qili Store at Gushan west of Gong through Gubai Ridge and divert the Luo into the Bian, so that transport could run in all four seasons.

sentences.zh: 詔都水監楊佐同往計度。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Director of Waterways Yang Zuo to go with him to survey and calculate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Director of Waterways Yang Zuo to accompany him in surveying the project.

sentences.zh: 歸，未及論功而卒。

translations.literal: He returned but died before his merit could be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: He returned, but died before his service could be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 田敏，字子俊，本易州牙吏。

translations.literal: Tian Min, style name Zijun, was originally a yamen clerk of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min, whose courtesy name was Zijun, was originally a yamen clerk of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，王師討幽薊，曹彬進兵涿州，敵斷其後。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era, when the imperial army marched against You and Ji, Cao Bin advanced on Zhuozhou and the enemy cut off his rear.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongxi campaign against You and Ji, Cao Bin advanced on Zhuozhou while the enemy cut off his rear.

sentences.zh: 王繼恩募勇士持書抵彬，敏應募，間行由祁溝關達涿州。

translations.literal: Wang Jien recruited brave men to carry a letter to Bin; Min answered the call and, traveling by hidden routes through Qigou Pass, reached Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jien recruited brave men to carry a message to Bin; Min volunteered, slipped through by hidden routes via Qigou Pass, and reached Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 彬得詔，選壯士五十人衛敏還，道遇賊，力戰，四十八人死，敏與兩人者，僅以身免。

translations.literal: Bin received the edict and chose fifty stalwart men to escort Min back; on the road they met bandits and fought hard — forty-eight died, and Min with two others barely escaped with their lives.
translations.idiomatic: When Bin received the edict, he chose fifty stalwart men to escort Min back; on the road they met raiders and fought hard — forty-eight were killed, and only Min and two others barely escaped alive.

sentences.zh: 彬上其事，太宗召見，復令齎詔諭彬。

translations.literal: Bin reported the affair, and Taizong summoned Min for an audience and again ordered him to carry an edict instructing Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Bin reported the matter to court; Taizong summoned Min for an audience and again ordered him to carry an edict instructing Bin.

sentences.zh: 師還，補敏易州靜砦指揮使。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Min was appointed commander of Jing Stockade at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the army withdrew, Min was appointed commander of Jing Stockade at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，以所部兵屯定州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Duangong era, he garrisoned Dingzhou with the troops under his command.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Duangong era, he stationed his command at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 契丹攻北唐河，大將李繼隆遣部將逆戰，為敵所乘。

translations.literal: When the Khitan attacked North Tanghe River, the great general Li Jilong sent a subordinate to meet them in battle and was overrun by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan attacked North Tanghe River, the great general Li Jilong sent a subordinate to meet them and was overrun.

sentences.zh: 奄至水南。

translations.literal: They suddenly reached the south bank of the river.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy suddenly reached the south bank of the river.

sentences.zh: 敏以百騎奮擊，敵懼，退水北，遂引去。

translations.literal: Min charged with one hundred horsemen; the enemy feared him, withdrew north of the water, and then withdrew altogether.
translations.idiomatic: Min charged with one hundred horsemen; the enemy took fright, fell back north of the river, and then withdrew altogether.

sentences.zh: 又出狼山，襲契丹，至滿城，獲首級甚眾。

translations.literal: He again went out from Langshan, raided the Khitan as far as Mancheng, and took many heads.
translations.idiomatic: He again marched out from Langshan, struck the Khitan as far as Mancheng, and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 既而敵陷易州，敏失其家所在。

translations.literal: Before long the enemy captured Yizhou, and Min lost track of where his family was.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the enemy captured Yizhou, and Min lost track of his family's whereabouts.

sentences.zh: 帝擢敏本軍都虞候，賜白金三百兩，使間行求其父母，得之以歸。

translations.literal: The Emperor promoted Min to chief adjutant of his command, granted him three hundred taels of white gold, and sent him by hidden routes to seek his parents; he found them and brought them back.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor promoted Min to chief adjutant of his command, granted him three hundred taels of white gold, and sent him by hidden routes to find his parents; he recovered them and brought them home.

sentences.zh: 徙屯鎮州，而升其指揮為內員僚直。

translations.literal: He moved his garrison to Zhenzhou and had his command raised to the Inner Staff Straight Corps.
translations.idiomatic: He moved his garrison to Zhenzhou, and his command was raised to the Inner Staff Straight Corps.

sentences.zh: 李繼隆討夏州，奏隸麾下。

translations.literal: When Li Jilong campaigned against Xiazhou, he memorialized to have Min serve under his command.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jilong campaigned against Xiazhou, he asked that Min serve under his command.

sentences.zh: 敏率兵至靈州橐駝口雙塠西，遇敵，斬首三千級，獲羊馬、橐駝、鎧仗數萬計。

translations.literal: Min led troops to the west of Shuangtai at Tuokou of Lingzhou, met the enemy, beheaded three thousand of them, and captured sheep, horses, camels, and armor and weapons numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Min led troops to the west of Shuangtai at Tuokou of Lingzhou, met the enemy, took three thousand heads, and captured sheep, horses, camels, and armor and weapons numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 繼隆上其功，遷御前忠佐馬步軍副都軍頭。

translations.literal: Jilong reported his merit, and Min was transferred to Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Loyal Retainers Before the Throne, infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Jilong reported his achievements, and Min was promoted to Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Loyal Retainers Before the Throne, infantry and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 既而又從傅潛於定州。

translations.literal: Before long he again followed Fu Qian at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again served under Fu Qian at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時契丹斷蒲陰路，城中有神勇軍士千餘人。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitan had cut the Puyin road, and within the city were more than a thousand soldiers of the Divine Courage Corps.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Khitan had cut the Puyin road; inside the city were more than a thousand soldiers of the Divine Courage Corps.

sentences.zh: 屬敵兵盛，不敢戰，敏率輕銳援出之。

translations.literal: Because the enemy force was strong, they did not dare to fight; Min led picked light troops to relieve and bring them out.
translations.idiomatic: With the enemy force strong, they dared not fight; Min led picked light troops to break through and bring them out.

sentences.zh: 真宗幸天雄軍，詔敏隸高瓊，使追賊至寧遠軍，以功領涿州刺史。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong visited Tianxiong Army, an edict ordered Min to serve under Gao Qiong and pursue the bandits as far as Ningyuan Army; for his merit he received the prefecture of Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong visited Tianxiong Army, Min was ordered to serve under Gao Qiong and pursue the raiders as far as Ningyuan Army; for his merit he received the prefecture of Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 王均亂西川，從招安使雷有終敗賊於靈池山。

translations.literal: When Wang Jun rebelled in western Sichuan, Min followed the pacification commissioner Lei Youzhong in defeating the bandits at Lingchi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Jun rebelled in western Sichuan, Min followed the pacification commissioner Lei Youzhong in defeating the rebels at Lingchi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賊平，遷馬步軍都軍頭。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he was transferred to Commander-in-Chief of infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were crushed, he was promoted to Commander-in-Chief of infantry and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，契丹復入寇，敏從王顯為鎮、定先鋒，大敗契丹於遂城西羊山，斬其酋長。

translations.literal: In the Xianping era, when the Khitan again invaded, Min served under Wang Xian as vanguard for Zhen and Ding and routed the Khitan at West Yangshan in Suizhou, beheading their chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianping era, when the Khitan again invaded, Min served under Wang Xian as vanguard for Zhen and Ding and routed the Khitan at West Yangshan in Suizhou, beheading their chieftain.

sentences.zh: 真授單州刺史，後為邢州兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: He was truly appointed prefect of Shanzhou and later became military control commissioner of Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed prefect of Shanzhou and later became military control commissioner of Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，從王起屯定州，遇契丹於望都，逆戰，斬首二千餘級。

translations.literal: Before long he followed Wang Qi in garrisoning Dingzhou, met the Khitan at Wangdu, gave battle, and beheaded more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he followed Wang Qi in garrisoning Dingzhou, met the Khitan at Wangdu, gave battle, and took more than two thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 徙北平砦兵馬鈐轄，領騎兵五千以當其衝。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military control commissioner of Beiping Stockade and led five thousand cavalry to meet their thrust.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military control commissioner of Beiping Stockade and led five thousand cavalry to block their advance.

sentences.zh: 先是，兩地供輸民多為契丹鄉導，敏自魚臺北悉驅南徙，凡七百餘戶，送定州。

translations.literal: Before this, transport-supply commoners in the two regions had often served the Khitan as local guides; Min drove all of them south from north of Yutai — more than seven hundred households in all — and sent them to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, transport-supply commoners in the border regions had often guided the Khitan; Min drove all of them south from north of Yutai — more than seven hundred households in all — and resettled them at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷北平砦總管，賜御劍，聽以便宜從事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to overall commander of Beiping Stockade, granted the imperial sword, and permitted to act at his discretion.
translations.idiomatic: He was made overall commander of Beiping Stockade, granted the imperial sword, and permitted to act at his discretion.

sentences.zh: 至是，契丹復入寇，復與敵戰楊村，敗之。

translations.literal: At this time the Khitan again invaded; he again fought the enemy at Yang Village and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan again invaded, he fought them again at Yang Village and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 敏諜知契丹主去北平十里蒲陰駐砦，敏夜率銳兵，襲破其營帳。

translations.literal: Min learned by espionage that the Khitan ruler had encamped at Puyin ten li from Beiping; at night he led picked troops and stormed their camp, breaking it.
translations.idiomatic: Learning by espionage that the Khitan ruler had encamped at Puyin ten li from Beiping, Min led picked troops by night and stormed the camp, breaking it.

sentences.zh: 契丹主大驚，問撻覽曰：「今日戰者誰？

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler was greatly alarmed and asked Talan, "Who fought today?
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler was greatly alarmed and asked Talan, "Who fought us today?

sentences.zh: 」撻覽曰：「所謂田廂使者。

translations.literal: Talan said, "The one called the Tianxiang envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Talan said, "The one called the Tianxiang envoy."

sentences.zh: 」契丹主曰：「其鋒銳不可當。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler said, "His edge is too sharp to withstand.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler said, "His edge is too sharp to withstand."

sentences.zh: 」遂引眾去。

translations.literal: Then he withdrew with his force.
translations.idiomatic: Then he withdrew with his army.

sentences.zh: 敵攻瀛州不下，欲乘虛犯貝、魏，詔敏與魏能、張凝三路兵，入敵境縱擊，以牽其勢。

translations.literal: The enemy failed to take Yingzhou and wished to exploit an opening to strike Bei and Wei; an edict ordered Min together with Wei Neng and Zhang Ning to lead three columns into enemy territory and strike freely to pull their momentum.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to take Yingzhou, the enemy wished to exploit an opening to strike Bei and Wei; an edict ordered Min, Wei Neng, and Zhang Ning to lead three columns into enemy territory and strike freely to check their advance.

sentences.zh: 敏出西路，抵易州南十里，屯師石村，虜獲人畜、鎧仗以萬計。

translations.literal: Min went out by the western route, reached a point ten li south of Yizhou, and encamped his army at Shicun; he captured men, livestock, and armor and weapons numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Min marched by the western route, reached a point ten li south of Yizhou, and encamped at Shicun; he captured men, livestock, and armor and weapons numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 尋詔三路兵還定州，敏遇敵於鎮州之北馬頭嶺，復大破之。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered the three columns back to Dingzhou; Min met the enemy north of Matou Ridge in Zhenzhou and again routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the three columns were ordered back to Dingzhou; north of Matou Ridge in Zhenzhou Min met the enemy again and routed them.

sentences.zh: 契丹請和，乃徙敏鎮定路都鈐轄，遷本州團練使，充鎮定路總管。

translations.literal: When the Khitan sued for peace, Min was transferred to overall military control commissioner of the Zhending Circuit, promoted to regimental commander of the prefecture, and made overall commander of the Zhending Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan sued for peace, Min was made overall military control commissioner of the Zhending Circuit, promoted to regimental commander of the prefecture, and appointed overall commander of the Zhending Circuit.

sentences.zh: 徙永興軍、陝州，曆鄜延、環慶、鳳翔三路，久之，為環慶路都總管。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Yongxing Army and Shaanzhou, served successively on the Yanyan, Huanqing, and Fengxiang circuits, and after some time became overall commander of the Huanqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yongxing Army and Shaanzhou, served in turn on the Yanyan, Huanqing, and Fengxiang circuits, and in time became overall commander of the Huanqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時後橋屬羌數擾邊，敏誅違命者十八族，又敗羅骨於三店川，遷鄭州防禦使、涇原路總管，後徙環慶。

translations.literal: At the time dependent tribes beyond Houqiao repeatedly disturbed the frontier; Min executed the disobedient among eighteen clans, again defeated Luogu at Sandian River, was transferred to defender of Zhengzhou and overall commander of the Jingyuan Circuit, and later moved to Huanqing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time dependent tribes beyond Houqiao repeatedly raided the frontier; Min executed the disobedient among eighteen clans, again defeated Luogu at Sandian River, was made defender of Zhengzhou and overall commander of the Jingyuan Circuit, and later moved to Huanqing.

sentences.zh: 坐與部豪往還納賂為不法，降左屯衛大將軍、昭州防禦使。

translations.literal: Because of exchanging bribes with tribal chiefs and engaging in unlawful conduct, he was demoted to Grand General of the Left Garrison Guard and defender of Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: For exchanging bribes with tribal chiefs and engaging in unlawful conduct, he was demoted to Grand General of the Left Garrison Guard and defender of Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 既而以虢州圍練使知隰州，復為環慶路都總管、儀州防禦使，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he served as regimental commander of Guozhou with charge of Xizhou, again became overall commander of the Huanqing Circuit and defender of Yizhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he served as regimental commander of Guozhou while governing Xizhou, again became overall commander of the Huanqing Circuit and defender of Yizhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 敏在邊二十餘年，凡遷授，多以功伐，雖晚不自飭，而朝廷亦優容之。

translations.literal: Min spent more than twenty years on the frontier; nearly every promotion came through military achievement. Though in his later years he did not restrain himself, the court still indulged him.
translations.idiomatic: Min spent more than twenty years on the frontier, and nearly every promotion came through military achievement; though in his later years he failed to restrain himself, the court still indulged him.

sentences.zh: 侍其曙

translations.literal: Shi Qishu
translations.idiomatic: —— Shi Qishu ——

sentences.zh: 侍其曙，字景升。

translations.literal: Shi Qishu, style name Jingsheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Qishu, whose courtesy name was Jingsheng.

sentences.zh: 父稹，左監門衛大將軍。

translations.literal: His father Zhen served as Grand General of the Left Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhen served as Grand General of the Left Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 曙少舉進士不第，以父任為殿前承旨，改右班殿直。

translations.literal: In youth Shi presented himself for the jinshi examination without success; through his father's appointment he became Palace Attendant before the Throne Hall and was changed to Right Team Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Shi sat for the jinshi examination without success; through his father's appointment he became Palace Attendant before the Throne Hall and was reassigned as Right Team Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，以閤門祗候為蘇、杭、湖、秀等州都巡檢使。

translations.literal: In the Xianping era, as Chamberlain Attendant he served as overall patrol inspector of Su, Hang, Hu, and Xiu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianping era, as Chamberlain Attendant he served as overall patrol inspector of Su, Hang, Hu, and Xiu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 遷左侍禁，領東西排岸司，與謝德權提舉在京倉草場。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Palace Guard, took charge of the East and West Embankment Offices, and together with Xie Dequan supervised the capital granary hay fields.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Left Palace Guard, took charge of the East and West Embankment Offices, and together with Xie Dequan supervised the capital granary hay fields.

sentences.zh: 嘗於倉隙地牧牛羊，為德權所訟。

translations.literal: He once pastured cattle and sheep in the spaces between granaries and was sued by Dequan.
translations.idiomatic: He once pastured cattle and sheep in the spaces between granaries and was reported by Dequan.

sentences.zh: 真宗以問德權曰：「牛羊食倉粟邪？

translations.literal: Zhenzong asked Dequan, "Did the cattle and sheep eat the granary grain?
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong asked Dequan, "Did the cattle and sheep eat the granary grain?

sentences.zh: 」 曙聞而自劾，帝勉諭之。

translations.literal: When Shi heard this he impeached himself; the Emperor comforted and instructed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi heard this he impeached himself; the Emperor comforted him and urged him on.

sentences.zh: 它日，召曙問：「汝才孰與德權？

translations.literal: Another day he summoned Shi and asked, "How does your talent compare with Dequan's?
translations.idiomatic: On another day he summoned Shi and asked, "How does your talent compare with Dequan's?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「德權畏法慎事，臣乃敢於官倉牧牛羊，是不及也。

translations.literal: He answered, "Dequan fears the law and is careful in affairs; I dared to pasture cattle and sheep in the official granary — in that I fall short.
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "Dequan fears the law and is careful in affairs; I dared to pasture cattle and sheep in the official granary — in that I fall short."

sentences.zh: 」人多稱之。

translations.literal: Many people praised him for this.
translations.idiomatic: Many people praised him for this.

sentences.zh: 鄂州男子聞人若挫，告其徒永興民李琰將作亂，命曙同度支判官李應機往按之。

translations.literal: A man of Ezhou named Wenren Ruocuo reported that his follower Li Yan of Yongxing was plotting rebellion; the throne ordered Shi together with Fiscal Affairs adjudication officer Li Yingji to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: A man of Ezhou named Wenren Ruocuo reported that his follower Li Yan of Yongxing was plotting rebellion; the throne ordered Shi, together with Fiscal Affairs adjudication officer Li Yingji, to investigate.

sentences.zh: 至則設方略，捕琰黨三十餘人，皆伏法。

translations.literal: When they arrived they laid plans, captured more than thirty of Yan's followers, and all were executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival they laid their plans, captured more than thirty of Yan's followers, and all were executed according to law.

sentences.zh: 琰辭連己所不快者數十人，一切不問。

translations.literal: Yan's confession implicated several tens of people he disliked, but Shi ignored them all.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's confession implicated several tens of people he disliked, but Shi ignored them all.

sentences.zh: 青州卒龐德訟其校李緒謀以眾叛，帝疑其誣，又命曙至青州，與通判魏德昇同至劾，無驗，遂棄德市。

translations.literal: A soldier of Qingzhou named Pang De accused his company commander Li Xu of plotting to lead the men in rebellion; the Emperor suspected a false charge and again ordered Shi to Qingzhou; together with Vice Prefect Wei Desheng he investigated to the end and found no evidence, so De was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: A soldier of Qingzhou named Pang De accused his company commander Li Xu of plotting to lead the men in rebellion; the Emperor suspected a false charge and again ordered Shi to Qingzhou; together with Vice Prefect Wei Desheng he investigated thoroughly, found no evidence, and had De executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 知青州張齊賢奏曙擅戮人，帝曰：「不爾，無以安被告者。

translations.literal: Prefect of Qingzhou Zhang Qixian memorialized that Shi had executed a man on his own authority; the Emperor said, "Otherwise there would be no way to reassure the accused.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect of Qingzhou Zhang Qixian memorialized that Shi had executed a man on his own authority; the Emperor said, "Otherwise there would be no way to reassure the accused."

sentences.zh: 」曙還，奏德憚緒治軍嚴，故誣之。

translations.literal: When Shi returned he reported that De feared Xu's strict military discipline and therefore falsely accused him.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi returned he reported that De feared Xu's strict military discipline and therefore falsely accused him.

sentences.zh: 帝擢緒本軍虞候，而進曙東頭供奉官。

translations.literal: The Emperor promoted Xu to adjutant of his command and advanced Shi to Eastern Head Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor promoted Xu to adjutant of his command and advanced Shi to Eastern Head Attendant-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 初，太宗平河東，建塔於太原故城，塔毀，帝欲新之，遣內待經度，計工二百萬。

translations.literal: At first, when Taizong pacified Hedong, he built a pagoda in the old city of Taiyuan; when the pagoda was destroyed, the Emperor wished to rebuild it and sent a palace attendant to oversee the work, with labor estimated at two million.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Taizong pacified Hedong, he built a pagoda in the old city of Taiyuan; when the pagoda was destroyed, the Emperor wished to rebuild it and sent a palace attendant to oversee the work, with labor estimated at two million.

sentences.zh: 帝疑，命曙往，減費十九。

translations.literal: The Emperor was doubtful and ordered Shi to go; he reduced the cost by nineteen parts in twenty.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was doubtful and ordered Shi to go; he reduced the cost by nineteen parts in twenty.

sentences.zh: 改內殿崇班。

translations.literal: He was changed to Inner Hall Honored Ban.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Inner Hall Honored Ban.

sentences.zh: 祥符二年，黎州夷人為亂，詔曙乘驛往招撫，其酋首納款，殺牲為誓。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xiangfu, when the tribesmen of Lizhou rebelled, an edict ordered Shi to go by courier to win them over; their chieftains submitted and slaughtered animals in oath.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xiangfu, when the tribesmen of Lizhou rebelled, an edict ordered Shi to go by courier to win them over; their chieftains submitted and slaughtered animals in oath.

sentences.zh: 曙按行鹽井，夷人復叛。

translations.literal: While Shi was inspecting the salt wells, the tribesmen rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: While Shi was inspecting the salt wells, the tribesmen rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 曙率部兵百餘，生擒首領三人，斬首數十級。

translations.literal: Shi led more than a hundred troops of his command, captured three chieftains alive, and beheaded several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Shi led more than a hundred troops of his command, captured three chieftains alive, and beheaded several tens.

sentences.zh: 因上言蠻阻險拒命，請必加討。

translations.literal: He then submitted that the tribes, relying on rugged terrain, were resisting orders and requested that they be punished without fail.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted that the tribes, relying on rugged terrain, were resisting orders and requested that they be punished without fail.

sentences.zh: 詔知慶州孫正辭、環慶駐泊都監張繼勳領陝西兵，同曙俱進，所至皆降。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sun Zhengci, prefect of Qingzhou, and Zhang Jixun, overall garrison supervisor of Huanqing, to lead Shaanxi troops and advance together with Shi; wherever they went all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Sun Zhengci, prefect of Qingzhou, and Zhang Jixun, overall garrison supervisor of Huanqing, to lead Shaanxi troops and advance together with Shi; wherever they went all submitted.

sentences.zh: 曙又言：王師已至而方出，請誅之。

translations.literal: Shi again said, "They submitted only after the imperial army had arrived — I request that they be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Shi again said, "They submitted only after the imperial army had arrived — I request that they be executed.

sentences.zh: 真宗謂王旦曰：「 已降而殺之，何以信四夷？

translations.literal: Zhenzong said to Wang Dan, "If we kill them after they have submitted, how can the four barbarians trust us?
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong said to Wang Dan, "If we kill them after they have submitted, how can the four barbarians trust us?

sentences.zh: 」不許。

translations.literal: He did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 夷人平，遷內殿承制，再遷如京副使、知登州。

translations.literal: When the tribesmen were pacified, Shi was transferred to Inner Hall Artisan, and again promoted to Deputy Commissioner for the Capital and prefect of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the tribesmen were pacified, Shi was promoted to Inner Hall Artisan, and again to Deputy Commissioner for the Capital and prefect of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 會歲饑，請漕江、淮米以振貧乏，活者甚眾。

translations.literal: When famine struck that year, he requested transport of grain from the Jiang and Huai regions to relieve the poor; very many lives were saved.
translations.idiomatic: When famine struck that year, he requested grain from the Jiang and Huai regions to relieve the poor; very many lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 累遷西京作坊使、惠州刺史、知桂州，徙滑州，遷西上閤門使，徙鄆州，提舉在京諸司庫務，卒。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he became Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops, prefect of Huizhou, and governor of Guizhou, was transferred to Huazhou, rose to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant, moved to Yanzhou, took charge of the capital bureaus' storehouses, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Through repeated promotions he became Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops, prefect of Huizhou, and governor of Guizhou, was transferred to Huazhou, rose to Western Upper Chamberlain Attendant, moved to Yanzhou, took charge of the capital bureaus' storehouses, and died.

sentences.zh: 曙為人沈敏，有幹略，善論利害事，朝廷數任使之。

translations.literal: Shi was deep and keen by nature, possessed practical capacity, was skilled at discussing matters of advantage and harm, and the court repeatedly employed him on such tasks.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was deep and keen by nature, possessed practical capacity, was skilled at discussing matters of advantage and harm, and the court repeatedly entrusted him with such tasks.

sentences.zh: 康德輿

translations.literal: Kang Deyu
translations.idiomatic: —— Kang Deyu ——

sentences.zh: 康德輿，字世基，河南洛陽人。

translations.literal: Kang Deyu, style name Shiji, was a man of Luoyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Deyu, whose courtesy name was Shiji, came from Luoyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 父贊元，嘗以作坊使從曹光實襲李繼遷，獲其母妻，擢崇儀使、武州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Zanyuan once served as workshop commissioner under Cao Guangshi in the raid on Li Jiqian, capturing his mother and wife; he was promoted to Honored Ceremonies Commissioner and prefect of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zanyuan once served as workshop commissioner under Cao Guangshi in the raid on Li Jiqian, capturing Jiqian's mother and wife; he was promoted to Honored Ceremonies Commissioner and prefect of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 贊元死，真宗追其功，錄德輿三班奉職，遷右班殿直、涇原路走馬承受，擢閤門祗候。

translations.literal: When Zanyuan died, Zhenzong recalled his service, enrolled Deyu as Third-Rank Palace Attendant, transferred him to Right Team Palace Attendant and courier of the Jingyuan Circuit, and promoted him to Chamberlain Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Zanyuan died, Zhenzong recalled his service, enrolled Deyu as Third-Rank Palace Attendant, promoted him to Right Team Palace Attendant and courier of the Jingyuan Circuit, and elevated him to Chamberlain Attendant.

sentences.zh: 河齧陽武埽，詔遣德輿完築。

translations.literal: When the river gnawed at the Yangwu embankment, an edict dispatched Deyu to complete and repair it.
translations.idiomatic: When the river gnawed at the Yangwu embankment, an edict dispatched Deyu to complete and repair it.

sentences.zh: 歷開封府西路都巡檢、勾當榷貨務，皆兼領埽事。

translations.literal: He successively served as overall frontier inspector of the western route of Kaifeng Prefecture and superintendent of the Monopoly Bureau, in each case also overseeing embankment work.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as overall frontier inspector of the western route of Kaifeng Prefecture and superintendent of the Monopoly Bureau, in each case also overseeing embankment work.

sentences.zh: 改巡護開府等六州黃河堤岸。

translations.literal: He was changed to patrol superintendent of the Yellow River embankments of six prefectures including Kaifu.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as patrol superintendent of the Yellow River embankments of six prefectures including Kaifu.

sentences.zh: 天聖中，使夏州，賜趙德明冬服。

translations.literal: In the Tiansheng era he was sent on mission to Xiazhou and granted Zhao Deming winter clothing.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tiansheng era he was sent on mission to Xiazhou and granted Zhao Deming winter clothing.

sentences.zh: 夏人謂曰：「前康將軍戰靈武者，非先世邪？

translations.literal: The Xia said to him, "Was not the former General Kang who fought at Lingwu your ancestor?
translations.idiomatic: The Xia said to him, "Was not the former General Kang who fought at Lingwu your ancestor?

sentences.zh: 」德輿懼其復仇，紿曰：「非也。

translations.literal: Deyu feared vengeance and deceived them, saying, "He was not.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu feared vengeance and deceived them, saying, "He was not."

sentences.zh: 」還，勾當汴口，改西頭供奉官。

translations.literal: On his return he supervised the Bian River mouth and was changed to Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he supervised the Bian River mouth and was reassigned as Western Head Attendant-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 用樞密使曹利用薦，遷內殿崇班、河陰兵馬都監，建沿汴斗門以節水。

translations.literal: On the recommendation of Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Cao Liyong, he was transferred to Inner Hall Honored Ban and overall military supervisor of Heyin, and built sluice gates along the Bian to regulate the water.
translations.idiomatic: On the recommendation of Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Cao Liyong, he was promoted to Inner Hall Honored Ban and overall military supervisor of Heyin, and built sluice gates along the Bian to regulate the water.

sentences.zh: 會積雨，汴水將溢，德輿請自京西導水入護龍河，水得不溢。

translations.literal: When heavy rains accumulated and the Bian River was about to overflow, Deyu requested diverting water from west of the capital into the Protecting Dragon River, and the water did not overflow.
translations.idiomatic: When heavy rains accumulated and the Bian River was about to overflow, Deyu requested diverting water from west of the capital into the Protecting Dragon River, and the flood was averted.

sentences.zh: 歷知原州、慶州，益州路兵馬鈐轄，久之，領昭州刺史，徙幷代兵馬鈐轄、管勾麟府路軍馬事。

translations.literal: He successively served as prefect of Yuanzhou and Qingzhou, as Military Control Commissioner of Yizhou Circuit; after some time he held the title of Zhaozhou governor, then was transferred to Military Control Commissioner of Bing and Dai and Superintendent of army and horse affairs on the Qinfu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as prefect of Yuanzhou and Qingzhou and as Military Control Commissioner of Yizhou Circuit; in time he took the governorship of Zhaozhou, then was reassigned as Military Control Commissioner of Bing and Dai with charge of army and horse affairs on the Qinfu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 有蕃部乜羅為殿侍，求錦袍、驛料，德輿不與，乜羅頗出怨言。

translations.literal: There was a tribal man named Mi Luo who served as a palace attendant; he asked for a brocade robe and relay rations, but Deyu refused him, and Mi Luo voiced much resentment.
translations.idiomatic: A tribesman named Mi Luo, serving as a palace attendant, requested a brocade robe and relay provisions; Deyu refused, and Mi Luo began to speak bitterly.

sentences.zh: 後有譖乜羅與賊通，戰則反射漢人，乜羅無以自明，乃謀附賊。

translations.literal: Later someone slandered Mi Luo, saying he was in league with the enemy and would shoot back at Han Chinese in battle; Mi Luo had no way to clear himself and therefore planned to join the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Later someone accused Mi Luo of colluding with the enemy and of turning his bow on Han troops in battle; unable to prove his innocence, Mi Luo resolved to defect.

sentences.zh: 指揮張岊聞之，召乜羅與飲，乜羅泣曰：「我豈附賊者邪？

translations.literal: Commandant Zhang Jie heard of this, summoned Mi Luo to drink with him, and Mi Luo wept and said, "How could I be one who joins the enemy?
translations.idiomatic: When Commandant Zhang Jie heard, he invited Mi Luo to drink with him; Mi Luo wept and said, "Do you think I would join the enemy?

sentences.zh: 蓋逃死耳。

translations.literal: I only mean to flee and save my life."
translations.idiomatic: I only want to run away and save my life."

sentences.zh: 」岊以告德輿：「乜羅叛，信矣，不可不殺。

translations.literal: Jie reported this to Deyu: "Mi Luo's rebellion is certain; he cannot be spared."
translations.idiomatic: Jie told Deyu, "Mi Luo's defection is real. He must be killed."

sentences.zh: 」元昊方屢入寇，德輿不聽，曰：「今日豈殺蕃部時邪？

translations.literal: Yuan Hao was raiding repeatedly at the time, and Deyu would not listen, saying, "Is today the time to kill tribal people?"
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hao was raiding again and again, but Deyu would not heed him. "Is this the moment to kill tribal men?" he said.

sentences.zh: 」岊曰：「叛者特乜羅，非眾所欲也，請為君召與飲，仆崖谷中，聲言墮馬死，安知漢殺之？

translations.literal: Jie said, "The rebel is only Mi Luo himself, not what the masses want; let me invite him to drink for you, push him off in a cliff ravine, and say he fell from his horse and died — who would know the Han killed him?"
translations.idiomatic: Jie said, "Only Mi Luo is the rebel, not the rest. Let me summon him to drink, push him over a cliff, and say he fell from his horse — who would know we killed him?"

sentences.zh: 」德輿猶豫不決，以問所親，所親惡岊，短毀之，岊計不得行。

translations.literal: Deyu hesitated and could not decide; he asked those close to him, and since they disliked Jie they spoke ill of him, so Jie's plan was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu wavered and consulted his intimates; they hated Jie and slandered him, and Jie's plan came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 知府州折繼閔聞賊將至，以告德輿，德輿怒曰：「君不召之，何以知其來也！

translations.literal: Prefect of Fuzhou Zhe Jimin heard the enemy was about to arrive and told Deyu; Deyu flew into a rage and said, "If you did not summon them, how would you know they were coming!"
translations.idiomatic: When Zhe Jimin, prefect of Fuzhou, heard the enemy was near and warned Deyu, Deyu raged: "If you had not called them here, how would you know they were coming?"

sentences.zh: 」賊果以乜羅為響導，自後河川入襲府州。

translations.literal: The enemy indeed used Mi Luo as their guide and entered to attack Fuzhou by way of Houhechuan.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy did use Mi Luo as their guide, entering through Houhechuan to strike Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 蕃漢欲入城，德輿閉門不納，或降賊，或為賊所殺，不可勝計。

translations.literal: Tribal people and Han who wished to enter the city found Deyu had shut the gates and would not admit them; some surrendered to the enemy, some were killed by the enemy — the toll was beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Tribesmen and Han alike who tried to enter the city found the gates shut against them; some surrendered to the enemy, some were slaughtered — the dead were beyond count.

sentences.zh: 賊既圍府州，德輿與馬步軍副總管王元、兵馬鈐轄楊懷忠按兵不出戰，但移文轉運司調軍食。

translations.literal: Once the enemy had besieged Fuzhou, Deyu, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of infantry and cavalry Wang Yuan, and Military Control Commissioner Yang Huaizhong held their troops and would not give battle, but only sent official notices to the transport commission to requisition army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy besieged Fuzhou, Deyu, Wang Yuan the deputy commander of infantry and cavalry, and Military Control Commissioner Yang Huaizhong kept their armies idle and never fought, sending only dispatches to the transport office for rations.

sentences.zh: 轉運副使文彥博籍民輦運，至境以俟，而德輿等終不出。

translations.literal: Transport Deputy Commissioner Wen Yanbo registered the people to haul supplies by cart; they reached the border and waited, yet Deyu and the others never came out.
translations.idiomatic: Transport Deputy Commissioner Wen Yanbo conscripted civilians to haul grain; they reached the frontier and waited, but Deyu and his colleagues never emerged.

sentences.zh: 及陷豐州，才出屯州城數里，三日而還。

translations.literal: Only after Fengzhou fell did they go out and encamp a few li from the prefectural city, then returned after three days.
translations.idiomatic: Not until Fengzhou had fallen did they march out and camp a few li from the city — then returned three days later.

sentences.zh: 居民望見，以謂寇復至，皆棄其所齎，入保城郭。

translations.literal: When the residents saw them from afar, they took it for a fresh enemy attack and all abandoned what they were carrying and fled into the walled towns for refuge.
translations.idiomatic: The townspeople, seeing them from a distance, thought the raiders had returned; they dropped everything they carried and scrambled behind the walls.

sentences.zh: 然朝廷不悉聞，德輿止坐不出戰，降為東染院使、河陽兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Yet the court did not fully hear of it; Deyu was punished only for failing to give battle, and was demoted to Commissioner of the Eastern Dyeing Institute and Commander-in-Chief of army and horse at Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: The court never learned the full story. Deyu was punished only for refusing battle, demoted to Commissioner of the Eastern Dyeing Institute and Commander-in-Chief of army and horse at Heyang.

sentences.zh: 尋復昭州刺史、知保州，徙真定府定州路總管，歷知代、石、儀三州，大名府路鈐轄，提舉金堤，累遷西上閤門使。

translations.literal: Before long he was again made Governor of Zhaozhou and prefect of Baozhou, transferred to Overall Commander of Dingzhou Circuit under Zhending Prefecture, successively served as prefect of Dai, Shi, and Yi, Military Control Commissioner of Daming Prefecture Circuit, Superintendent of the Golden Embankment, and was repeatedly promoted to Western Upper Chamber Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he regained the governorship of Zhaozhou and the prefecture of Baozhou, then became Overall Commander of Dingzhou Circuit under Zhending Prefecture; he served in turn as prefect of Dai, Shi, and Yi, as Military Control Commissioner of Daming Prefecture Circuit, as Superintendent of the Golden Embankment, and rose repeatedly to Western Upper Chamber Attendant.

sentences.zh: 至和中，河決小吳埽，破東堤頓丘口，居民避水者趨堤上，而水至不得達，德輿以巨船五十，順流以濟之，遂免墊溺。

translations.literal: During the Zhihe era, the Yellow River broke at Xiao Wu Sao, breaching the eastern embankment at Dunqiu Mouth; residents fleeing the flood climbed the dike but could not escape when the water arrived. Deyu used fifty large boats to ferry them downstream and thus spared them from drowning and being submerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhihe era the Yellow River burst at Xiao Wu Sao and tore through the eastern dike at Dunqiu Mouth. People fleeing the flood climbed the embankment, only to find the water rising around them with nowhere to go. Deyu sent fifty large boats downstream to carry them off, saving them from drowning.

sentences.zh: 復領果州團練使、知冀州，徙趙州。

translations.literal: He again held the title of Guozhou regiment commander and served as prefect of Jizhou, then was transferred to Zhao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again held the title of Guozhou regiment commander and governed Jizhou, then was transferred to Zhao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有告雲翼卒謀以上元夜劫庫兵為亂，德輿會賓屬燕飲自若，陰遣人捕首謀誅之。

translations.literal: Someone reported that Yunyi garrison soldiers planned on Lantern Festival night to raid the armory and rebel; Deyu feasted with his staff as if nothing were amiss and secretly sent men to seize and execute the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: Word came that soldiers of the Yunyi garrison meant to raid the armory on Lantern Festival night and rise in revolt. Deyu held a banquet for his officers as though nothing were wrong, and in secret had the ringleaders seized and executed.

sentences.zh: 徙陳州鈐轄，卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Military Control Commissioner at Chenzhou and died there.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Military Control Commissioner at Chenzhou, where he died.

sentences.zh: 張昭遠

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan
translations.idiomatic: —— Zhang Zhaoyuan ——

sentences.zh: 張昭遠，字持正，滄州無棣人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan, courtesy name Chizheng, was a man of Wudi in Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan, whose courtesy name was Chizheng, came from Wudi in Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 父凝，殿前都虞候、寧州防禦使。

translations.literal: His father Ning served as Chief Adjutant before the Throne Hall and Defender of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ning was Chief Adjutant before the Throne Hall and Defender of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 契丹內寇，凝與康保裔伏兵瀛州，陷圍中。
