translations.literal: When the Khitan raided inland, Ning and Kang Baoyi lay in ambush at Yingzhou and were trapped in an encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan invaded, Ning and Kang Baoyi set an ambush at Yingzhou and were caught in an encirclement.

sentences.zh: 昭遠年十八，挺身掖出之，擢左班殿直、寄班祗候。

translations.literal: Zhaoyuan, eighteen years old, threw himself in and pulled them out; he was promoted to Left Team Palace Attendant and Acting Attendant of the Custodial Shift.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyuan was eighteen. He plunged in and dragged them free, and was promoted to Left Team Palace Attendant and Acting Attendant of the Custodial Shift.

sentences.zh: 每出使還，奏利害，多稱旨。

translations.literal: Whenever he returned from a mission abroad, he memorialized on advantages and risks, and most of his reports pleased the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Each time he returned from a diplomatic mission, he memorialized on what would help or harm the state — and the throne usually approved.

sentences.zh: 為忻州都巡檢，改閤門祗候、知狄山軍，管勾河東緣邊安撫司，再遷內殿崇班。

translations.literal: He served as Chief Frontier Inspector of Xinzhou, was changed to Attendant of the Ministry of Reception, commander of Dishan Army, Superintendent of the Hedong Frontier Pacification Office, and was promoted again to Inner Palace Honored Team Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He became Chief Frontier Inspector of Xinzhou, then Attendant of the Ministry of Reception and commander of Dishan Army, Superintendent of the Hedong Frontier Pacification Office, and was promoted again to Inner Palace Honored Team Attendant.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，閤門副使缺員，樞密院方奏擬人，真宗曰：「朕有人矣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianxi era, when a vacancy opened for Deputy Chamber Attendant, the Bureau of Military Affairs was just memorializing nominees when Emperor Zhenzong said, "I already have a man."
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianxi era a Deputy Chamber Attendant's post fell vacant; the Bureau of Military Affairs was drawing up nominations when Emperor Zhenzong said, "I already have someone in mind."

sentences.zh: 張昭遠知邊略，曹儀習朝儀，可並除西上閤門副使。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan knows frontier strategy, and Cao Yi is practiced in court ceremony; both may be appointed Western Upper Deputy Chamber Attendants at once."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan understands the frontier, and Cao Yi knows court ritual — appoint them both Western Upper Deputy Chamber Attendants."

sentences.zh: 」俄為河北緣邊安撫副使，尋知瀛州，改東上閤門副使、知定州，以引進副使復知瀛州，遷西上閤門使、知雄州。

translations.literal: Soon after he became Deputy Frontier Pacification Commissioner on the Hebei border; before long he was prefect of Yingzhou, then Eastern Upper Deputy Chamber Attendant and prefect of Dingzhou; as Deputy Introduction Commissioner he again governed Yingzhou, and was promoted to Western Upper Chamber Attendant and prefect of Xiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Deputy Frontier Pacification Commissioner on the Hebei border, then prefect of Yingzhou; he became Eastern Upper Deputy Chamber Attendant and prefect of Dingzhou, returned as Deputy Introduction Commissioner to govern Yingzhou again, and was promoted to Western Upper Chamber Attendant and prefect of Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 獻言歲會四榷場入中銀，帝謂輔臣曰：「先朝置榷場，所以通貨，非所以計貿易之利也。」

translations.literal: He proposed tallying the silver submitted at the four frontier markets each year; the Emperor told his chief ministers, "Our forebears established the frontier markets to circulate goods — not to reckon profit from trade."
translations.idiomatic: He suggested reporting each year the silver tendered at the four frontier markets. The Emperor told his ministers, "The earlier court set up these markets to keep goods flowing — not to count trade profits."

sentences.zh: 會大雨，陂塘大溢，昭遠勒兵築長堤，以捍其衝。

translations.literal: When heavy rains came and the ponds and reservoirs swelled greatly, Zhaoyuan drove his troops to build a long dike to hold back the flood surge.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains swelled the ponds and reservoirs until they threatened to burst; Zhaoyuan pressed his soldiers into building a long dike to hold the flood back.

sentences.zh: 徙鄜延路兵馬鈐轄，進都鈐轄，築堡成平川。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Military Control Commissioner of Fuyan Circuit, advanced to Overall Military Control Commissioner, and built the fortress at Chengpingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Military Control Commissioner of Fuyan Circuit, promoted to Overall Military Control Commissioner, and built the fortress at Chengpingchuan.

sentences.zh: 領忠州刺史、知成德軍，遷四方館使。

translations.literal: He held the title of Zhongzhou governor and commanded the Chengde Army, and was promoted to Agent of the Four Directions Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He held the governorship of Zhongzhou and command of the Chengde Army, and was promoted to Agent of the Four Directions Hall.

sentences.zh: 滹沱河決，壞城郭，乃修五關城，外環以堤，民至今為利。

translations.literal: When the Hutuo River burst its banks and ruined the walls and towns, he rebuilt Wuguan City and ringed it outside with an embankment — the people benefit from this to this day.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hutuo River broke and wrecked the walls and towns, he rebuilt Wuguan City and ringed it with an outer dike — a work the people still profit from today.

sentences.zh: 擢捧日天武四廂都指揮使、新州防禦使，歷步軍馬軍都虞候、嘉州防禦使，知代州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Overall Commander of the Four Divisions of the Holding-Sun and Heaven Martial Corps, Defender of Xinzhou, successively served as Chief Adjutant of infantry and cavalry, Defender of Jiazhou, and prefect of Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Overall Commander of the Four Divisions of the Holding-Sun and Heaven Martial Corps and Defender of Xinzhou, then served in turn as Chief Adjutant of infantry and cavalry, Defender of Jiazhou, and prefect of Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 召還，改莫州防禦使，罷管軍，授左龍武軍大將軍、昭州防禦使，卒。

translations.literal: Summoned back to court, he was made Defender of Mozhou, relieved of troop command, granted the post of Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Army and Defender of Zhaozhou, and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was made Defender of Mozhou, stripped of field command, and given the posts of Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Army and Defender of Zhaozhou; he died in office.

sentences.zh: 特贈應州觀察使。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the special title of Regimental Commissioner of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court specially posthumously granted him Regimental Commissioner of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 論曰：郭諮以其智巧材略，自見於功利之間，有足稱者。

translations.literal: Commentary: Guo Zi, by his ingenuity and talent for strategy, showed himself amid practical achievement — enough to merit praise.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Guo Zi had wit, skill, and strategic talent; in the realm of practical gain he showed enough to be worth naming.

sentences.zh: 曙，抑其次也，餘皆碌碌者矣。

translations.literal: Shu ranks second to him; the rest were mediocre men indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Qishu comes next, and after that the rest were undistinguished.

sentences.zh: 如方之禦寇，鑒之料敵，王果持法峭深，治軍嚴辦，茲其長也。

translations.literal: Shi's defense against invaders, Jian's reading of the enemy, Wang Guo's severe and exacting enforcement of law, and his strict and thorough management of troops — these were their strengths.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Fang knew how to hold off invaders; Lu Jian knew how to read the enemy; Wang Guo enforced the law with stern exactitude and ran his army with tight discipline — these were their gifts.

sentences.zh: 田敏屢有戰功，而貪墨敗度，幸容於時。

translations.literal: Tian Min won repeated battle honors, yet greed and corruption ruined his measure, and he was indulged by the times.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min won battle honors again and again, yet greed and corruption undid him — and the age indulged him nonetheless.

sentences.zh: 李渭治無遠略，一失機會，關中兵禍，數年不解。

translations.literal: Li Wei's governance lacked far-reaching design; one missed opportunity brought military disaster to Guanzhong, and for years there was no end to it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei governed without long vision; one lost chance brought years of military calamity to Guanzhong with no end in sight.

sentences.zh: 德輿閉城以棄其民，昭遠計榷場所入，焉知聖人懷柔之意哉。

translations.literal: Deyu shut the gates and abandoned his people; Zhaoyuan reckoned the revenues of the frontier markets — how could either know the sage's intent to win men through kindness?
translations.idiomatic: Deyu barred the gates and cast his people aside; Zhaoyuan counted the income from frontier markets — what did either know of the sage's way of winning hearts through gentleness?
